items.title: Pruning Autonomous Driving VLAs: What to Preserve for Reasoning and Action
items.description: Reasoning vision-language-action (VLA) models for autonomous driving use chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning to guide action generation, but incur substantial memory and computational costs.
items.ai_summary: Method called MoOP that combines reasoning and trajectory objectives to structurally prune vision-language-action models for autonomous driving while maintaining performance.

items.title: Lyris: Layout-Guided Long Video Generation with Persistent 3D Memory
items.description: Lyris uses persistent point-cloud memory and vision-language-model-authored 3D layouts to generate long, camera-controlled walkthroughs from a single photo, improving camera accuracy and return consistency.
items.ai_summary: Long video generation framework called Lyris that uses a persistent point-cloud memory and a vision-language model to create consistent camera-controlled walkthroughs from a single photo.

items.title: Modern Self-Supervised Vision Transformers Are Pareidolic
items.description: In human perception, pareidolia is the tendency to perceive a meaningful pattern, such as a face, in a random or ambiguous stimulus.We find a similar phenomenon in modern self-supervised Vision Transformers (ViTs): on white noise, which contains neither objects nor spatial…
items.ai_summary: Study finding that modern self-supervised Vision Transformers contain a pareidolic subspace that hinders object emergence, which can be mitigated using a training-free calibration method called PSC.

items.title: Let Vision-Language Models Generate Images through Their Representations
items.description: Recent unified multimodal models aim to combine visual understanding and generation within a single model, yet effectively integrating the two capabilities remains challenging.
items.ai_summary: Integral converts a pretrained vision-language model into a unified multimodal model by constructing a shared visual representation space, extending understanding capabilities to strong visual generation.

items.title: TowerBridge: Bridging the Dual-Encoder Modality Gap via Weight-Space Programming
items.description: CLIP-style dual encoders map images and text through two separate towers into a shared embedding space, where the two modalities occupy distinct regions separated by a modality gap.
items.ai_summary: TowerBridge is a weight-space programming recipe that bridges the CLIP dual-encoder modality gap to significantly improve image and text retrieval accuracy.

items.title: Language Models Steer on Injected Uncertainty Tokens, but Fail to Self-Monitor In Situ
items.description: Prompting language models to verbalize stepwise numerical confidence during generation is an increasingly popular approach for triggering backtracking and error correction in agentic reasoning.
items.ai_summary: Evaluations across math benchmarks demonstrate that open-weights language models fail to monitor their own in-situ reasoning errors despite steering well on injected uncertainty tokens.

items.title: How Far Can Linear Go? BiPert, a Unified Framework for Single-Cell Perturbation Modelling
items.description: Understanding how genetic perturbations affect cellular behaviour is essential for studying gene function and regulatory mechanisms. Large-scale CRISPR screens measure these effects across thousands of genes, but cover relatively few cellular contexts.
items.ai_summary: BiPert is a linear framework for single-cell perturbation modeling that predicts gene expression changes in unseen cell lines and identifies perturbed genes from transcriptional profiles.

items.title: Self-Supervised Dataset Distillation via Mutual Information Maximization
items.description: Mutual Information Prototype Alignment distills datasets for self-supervised learning by optimizing synthetic prototypes to preserve augmentation-invariant information and improve learned representations.
items.ai_summary: Mutual Information Prototype Alignment is a self-supervised dataset distillation approach that optimizes synthetic images to preserve augmentation-invariant information for improved neural network training.

items.title: Agentic AI for Intent Management and Control in Autonomous Communication Networks
items.description: Artificial intelligence (AI)-driven automation will help future mobile networks translate high-level network intents into concrete network optimization or control actions.
items.ai_summary: A triadic agentic AI framework co-designs intent management and fulfillment using a language model interpreter, optimizer, and controller to enable adaptive autonomous network operations.

items.title: CTLink: A Text-Prompted Segmentation Model for Linking Radiology Report Findings to 3D Chest CT Scans
items.description: Radiology reports describe findings in text only, without visually marking them on the scan, so readers cannot directly see which abnormality each reported finding refers to.
items.ai_summary: CTLink is a text-prompted 3D segmentation model that links radiology report findings to specific regions in chest CT scans.

items.title: LeJEPA Features Are Not Isotropic, and Should Not Be
items.description: The SIGReg term in LeJEPA regularizes features to have an isotropic Gaussian distribution. Our first result is to show that this regularizer, in practice, cannot achieve its goal. We design a modified regularizer to enforce the objective better.
items.ai_summary: PolarReg is a simple regularization term that enforces marginal distributions of magnitude and direction in self-supervised encoders without requiring strict independence.

items.title: Seeking in Space: Benchmarking Purposeful Active Exploration of Vision-Language Models for Spatial Reasoning
items.description: Humans explore unfamiliar spaces with purpose, deciding where to look until they have gathered the evidence a spatial question requires.
items.ai_summary: ActSpace-Bench is a benchmark for evaluating purposeful active exploration in vision-language models, revealing that top models seek evidence but are limited by memory.

items.title: Flood forecasting using a physics-guided conditional denoising diffusion probabilistic model
items.description: High-resolution flood forecasting with full two-dimensional shallow water equation (SWE) solvers remains computationally expensive, even on GPUs.
items.ai_summary: A conditional denoising diffusion probabilistic model provides fast, high-resolution ensemble flood forecasting by leveraging historical storm simulations and coarse hydrodynamic conditioning.

items.title: Verifying the Outputs of PDE Solvers: From Finite Elements to Neural Surrogates
items.description: Physics simulation outputs increasingly come from solvers that no expert inspects, such as third-party packages in automated pipelines, programs written by large language models (LLMs), and learned surrogates.
items.ai_summary: Framework that uses a small independent checker to verify the outputs of PDE solvers and neural surrogates, providing guaranteed error bounds against a written physics specification.

items.title: WorldLatent: A Unified 4D Latent Space for World Perception and Generation
items.description: WorldLatent unifies 4D perception and generation in a shared multimodal latent space, enabling a single model to perform zero-shot 4D perception, coherent 4D generation, and controllable editing.
items.ai_summary: Framework that introduces a unified 4D latent space to compress and fuse visual appearance, geometry, and dynamics into a single representation for simultaneous world perception and generation.

items.title: Matching Under Metric Privacy
items.description: We study how to represent and randomize points in $d$-dimensional Euclidean space to obtain accurate bipartite matchings under metric privacy.
items.ai_summary: Method that randomizes private points or their distances to public points in Euclidean space to obtain accurate bipartite matchings under metric privacy while providing privacy and utility guarantees.

items.title: ToolSmith: An Automatic Tool-Generation Framework for Multimodal Search Agents
items.description: Recent multimodal search agents use reasoning, vision, and live web search across many turns to answer questions beyond parametric knowledge by orchestrating a small library of hand-crafted search and visual tools.
items.ai_summary: Automatic tool-generation framework that grows and reuses modules on top of a lean base tool library to improve multimodal search agents across diverse benchmarks.

items.title: Learning Neurovascular Codes for EEG-to-fMRI Synthesis
items.description: In this paper, we introduce Neurovascular Codes as shared EEG representations for fMRI generation. We first train a separate EEG encoder to predict each fMRI signal, learning target-specific temporal and spectral features from the same EEG window.
items.ai_summary: Model that learns shared neurovascular codes as EEG representations using stochastic interpolants to synthesize and sample diverse fMRI signals from EEG windows.

items.title: Know When to Abstain: Conformal Confidence Estimation for Text-to-SQL
items.description: Text-to-SQL systems often return queries that execute successfully but answer the wrong question. Detecting these errors at deployment is hard because execution correctness is defined against a gold query, which exists only in labeled data.
items.ai_summary: Probabilistic query validation framework that combines a generator and a critic model with conformal calibration to estimate confidence and control error rates in Text-to-SQL systems.

items.title: CO-GRAFT: Attributing Reinforcement Learning Gains in Search Agents via Role-Level Policy Grafting
items.description: Reinforcement learning (RL) improves large language model search agents by up to 32 exact-match (EM) points over their pre-RL initializations, yet overall accuracy gains do not identify which underlying functional capabilities improve or interact during training.
items.ai_summary: Reward-agnostic attribution framework that uses role-level policy grafting and Shapley values to decompose and analyze reinforcement learning gains across different functional roles in search agents.

items.title: On-Policy Codec Distillation for Efficient All-in-One Video Generation
items.description: Modern visual generative models operate on tokens, and every visual asset they receive, whether an identity, a scribble, a depth map, or a motion video, is tokenized and appended to the input token sequence. Consequently, conditioning quickly dominates the computation cost.
items.ai_summary: Method that combines classical video codec-based token pruning with on-site self-distillation to speed up video generation and reduce memory usage by eliminating redundant condition tokens.

items.title: Needwise: Generation-Free Conversational Recommendation from Need-Level Typed Decisions
items.description: Conversational recommenders must rank items against needs that catalogs record only in part, while users add, withdraw and reverse needs and switch between requests.
items.ai_summary: Conversational recommendation system that ranks items using typed decisions and option probabilities instead of generated text, offering faster responses and lower costs than LLM rankers.

items.title: Reducing Order Sensitivity in Decision Models
items.description: Decision models are emerging as fast components of larger AI systems. Yet recent decision models, such as Jev, process options sequentially, leading to different predictions based on their ordering.
items.ai_summary: Method utilizing tree attention to achieve order invariance in decision models, reducing order sensitivity and improving reliability with little to no loss in predictive accuracy.

items.title: EEG Decoding in Context: A Framework for Tuning-Free EEG Foundation Models
items.description: Electroencephalography (EEG) decoding is a central route toward brain-computer interfaces for communication, rehabilitation, cognitive assessment, and neurological monitoring.
items.ai_summary: Framework that combines EEG-specific context construction with a frozen in-context predictor and metric-based adaptation to decode EEG signals without task-specific fine-tuning.

items.title: Precision-Aware Learning Rate Transfer Across Block Count in LLM Post-Training
items.description: The post-training of pretrained large language models, including supervised finetuning (SFT), direct preference optimization (DPO), and reinforcement learning with verifiable reward (RLVR), is very sensitive to the learning rate, and tuning it through grid search is costly in…
items.ai_summary: Method called TipSweep that transfers learning rates across different numbers of trainable transformer blocks during large language model post-training to reduce tuning costs.

items.title: When Does Overriding the Majority Vote Help?
items.description: When should additional reasoning or verification replace a majority-vote answer? We call such a replacement an override. We examine two obstacles: the availability of correct alternatives and the reliability of methods that produce or select them.
items.ai_summary: Comparative analysis of when additional reasoning, executed programs, or cross-model reasoning can successfully override majority-vote answers in language models.

items.title: SPROUT: Predicting Objective-Grounded Prompt Utility for Efficient Text-to-Image Preference Tuning
items.description: Preference tuning of text-to-image diffusion models spends most of its compute generating candidate images, yet training prompts are typically sampled uniformly at random, wasting compute generating images that provide too little signal for model alignment.
items.ai_summary: Method called SPROUT that uses a text-only utility predictor and a randomized acceptance rule to select informative training prompts for efficient text-to-image preference tuning.

items.title: Analyzing and Improving FlowMap Distillation of Autoregressive Video Models
items.description: FlowMap distillation offers a natural route to few-step generative modeling by directly learning a teacher's denoising trajectories.
items.ai_summary: Approach for few-step autoregressive video generation that applies anti-drifting guidance and motion-aware guidance to improve FlowMap distillation quality and reduce rollout drift.

items.title: Habitats: A Framework for Open-Ended Evolution of Agent Objectives
items.description: Designing what an agent should optimize can be as difficult as optimizing the agent itself.
items.ai_summary: Framework called Habitats that maintains an evolving population of reward-policy pairs to generate diverse and high-performing executable agent objectives automatically.

items.title: Tokens as Locality-Preserving Anchors: Scalable Novel View Synthesis with Target-Adaptive Token Routing
items.description: Transformer-based view synthesis models render each target viewpoint from the source images, without an explicit 3D representation, which lets them reproduce fine detail and view-dependent effects.
items.ai_summary: Transformer-based view synthesis model that uses a target-adaptive token router to select a fixed budget of spatial anchor tokens, enabling fast and scalable novel view rendering.

items.title: Attention Latent Feedback
items.description: During autoregressive decoding, the deeper representations of the previous token have already been computed, yet shallow layers at the current token cannot read them directly because standard self-attention connects positions only at the same depth.
items.ai_summary: Architecture called Attention Latent Feedback that allows sublayers in autoregressive decoding to attend to deeper layer outputs from previous positions, improving language model performance.

items.title: Optimal Regret Lower Bounds in Matrix Games
items.description: We study learning in two-player zero-sum games, also known as matrix games, in which two players with $m$ and $n$ actions repeatedly select mixed strategies for $T$ rounds.
items.ai_summary: Theoretical study establishing optimal regret lower bounds of deterministic learning dynamics in two-player zero-sum matrix games.

items.title: SodovaFo7/claude-code-unlimited
items.description: Rotate Claude Code sessions automatically. Never hit the limit again.
items.ai_summary: SodovaFo7/claude-code-unlimited is a session rotation engine for Claude Code CLI that automatically detects limit messages and rotates sessions in place.

items.title: Head Anything: Correspondence-Guided Joint Generation of 3D Heads from Few Images
items.description: Large image-to-3D generators recover detailed heads from a single photograph but treat every image as a new object. For several images of one person, they hallucinate unseen regions independently without using information from the other images.
items.ai_summary: Framework called Head Anything that converts a pretrained single-image 3D head generator into a joint multi-image generator using lightweight correspondence-attention adapters.

items.title: HoloSplat: Real-Time Token Streaming for Feed-Forward Human Reconstruction
items.description: Live free-viewpoint video streaming of humans enables immersive telepresence and interactive XR applications. However, this requires reconstructing each frame in real time, transmitting the data within strict bandwidth budgets, and decoding it on lightweight client GPUs.
items.ai_summary: HoloSplat is a real-time streaming framework for human-centric volumetric video that uses server-side token compression and client-side restoration to stream high-quality 3D Gaussians at high frame rates.

items.title: Deneb-Vritra: Descriptions, Edges and Names Examined by Blocking Via Restoring Token Representations and Attention
items.description: Laya is a 421M-parameter encoder that answers a question about a text in one pass: each answer option, written as a name plus a description, gets a marker token, and one score is read from the network at each marker.
items.ai_summary: Laya is a 421M-parameter encoder that evaluates text questions, and researchers show that blocking attention from answer markers to specific name tokens in middle layers significantly reduces name shortcuts without hurting overall accuracy.

items.title: SRCWDNet: Semantic-Relational Cross-Window Dual-Graph Network for Multi-Label Remote Sensing Scene Classification
items.description: Multi-label remote sensing scene classification remains a challenging task due to complex spatial-spectral patterns, extreme class imbalance, and inter-label dependencies that are often insufficiently modeled.
items.ai_summary: SRCWDNet is a semantic-relational cross-window dual-graph network designed to improve multi-label remote sensing scene classification by jointly modeling visual attention and adaptive label correlations.

items.title: Serialization and the Character-System: Measuring Narrative Concentration in French Fiction (1800--1940)
items.description: Every novel divides a finite quantity of narrative attention among its characters, and whether the shape of that division, between a narrative organized around a single figure and one spread across a crowd, has a history is far less settled than the abundance of critical…
items.ai_summary: Researchers analyze narrative concentration across 12,011 French novels published between 1800 and 1940 using the Gini coefficient of PageRank distributions over character networks, finding a U-shaped trajectory over the nineteenth century.

items.title: Genome-to-Image Translation: Reconstructing Escherichia coli Morphology from Genomic Sequences
items.description: Antimicrobial resistance in Escherichia coli is established in routine practice by culture-based susceptibility testing, which is slow relative to the clinical need for an early treatment decision.
items.ai_summary: Researchers propose a conditional image-generation method using whole-genome sequencing data and a generative adversarial network to reconstruct Escherichia coli colony morphology and improve antimicrobial resistance classification.

items.title: FATCAT: Fault Injection Attacks Targeting Chip-level Alignment
items.description: Model alignment is the primary safety and security mechanism for enforcing refusal of malicious prompts in modern foundation models; yet, existing adversarial evaluations implicitly assume underlying hardware integrity.
items.ai_summary: FATCAT is a physical electromagnetic fault-injection attack that targets GPU-accelerated systems to corrupt memory transactions and eliminate safety refusal mechanisms in modern large language and vision-language models.

items.title: CrownFusion: 3D Dental Crown Generation Using Geometry Images and Latent Diffusion
items.description: We introduce CrownFusion, a latent diffusion model to generate 3D dental crown designs from geometry images, a 2D-grid encoding of surface coordinates.
items.ai_summary: CrownFusion is a latent diffusion model that generates 3D dental crown designs from geometry images while preserving fine geometric detail and producing anatomically plausible variations tailored to individual patients.

items.title: Data-Driven Identification of Uncertainty Sets with Conformance Guarantees
items.description: Formal verification and controller synthesis require accurate models. Conformance relations specify the required accuracy of a model such that properties established for the model carry over to the target system.
items.ai_summary: ConfID is a unified framework that establishes reachset, trace, and simulation conformance for nonlinear systems by identifying data-driven uncertainty sets with distribution-free probabilistic guarantees.

items.title: WeaveVLA: 3D Relational Grounding for Vision-Language-Action Models
items.description: Vision-language-action (VLA) models leverage pretrained vision-language representations for instruction-conditioned robot control, yet their understanding of task-relevant 3D relations and how these relations evolve during manipulation remains largely implicit.

items.title: Site-Conditioned Boundary Closure for Subsurface Seepage Forecasting and Relief Placement
items.description: Truncating a large heterogeneous diffusion model around a localized, threshold-activated outlet saves degrees of freedom but severs exterior feedback that governs when the outlet opens and how much it discharges.
items.ai_summary: Site-Conditioned Boundary Closure is a modeling approach that maps local physical descriptors to exchange coefficients at cut boundaries to improve subsurface seepage forecasting and relief placement.

items.title: Self-Upgrading Embodied Agents
items.description: An embodied agent built on a language model goes to work with the weights it was given and keeps them for life. To get better, it needs more training, or reflection, memory, search or prompts that cost every step and are lost when the task changes.
items.ai_summary: Researchers introduce a self-upgrading embodied agent that learns from its daily experiences by autonomously testing and rewriting a tensor of its own weights between tasks without requiring gradient training or external reward models.

items.title: RUIBench: What Makes a Good Robot-Use Interface?
items.description: Foundation models can reason about complex physical tasks, yet translating this intelligence into reliable robot execution remains challenging.

items.title: Attention Temperature Confounds Zero-Shot Context Extension
items.description: A training-time attention change is usually judged for zero-shot context extension against a dense baseline beyond the training length at the default temperature, $τ= 1$.
items.ai_summary: Method for LLM zero-context extension that calibrates attention temperature to remove miscalibration artifacts and false advantages from baseline comparisons.

items.title: Look Back, Draft Ahead: Corrective Prefix Attention for Parallel Speculative Decoding
items.description: Parallel speculative decoders propose an entire token block at once, yet one early inconsistency can cause the target to reject its remaining suffix.
items.ai_summary: Parallel speculative decoding method called Corrective Prefix Attention that combines prefix selection with autoregressive supervision to accelerate token generation.

items.title: Preflight: Agentic Last-Mile Verification for AI Software Supply Chains
items.description: Software dependencies execute within the trust boundary of downstream applications, yet provenance, static analysis, and package-level behavioral approaches do not directly determine how a released artifact behaves for a specific program.
items.ai_summary: Program-scoped pre-execution verifier called Preflight that analyzes Python dependencies in a restricted environment to detect malicious behavior for downstream applications.

items.title: LiveLoRA: Exact KV Cache Migration Across LoRA Updates for LLM Agents
items.description: Updating an LLM adapter should not require replaying the full interaction history of every active session.
items.ai_summary: Model-runtime co-design called LiveLora that enables exact final-block key-value cache migration across adapter updates without replaying full interaction histories.

items.title: SayWhen: Set-Valued Semantic Commitment for Low-Regret Early Speech
items.description: Speaking early turns a prediction into an irreversible public commitment. We introduce SayWhen, a test-time controller that selects a task-directed act shared across typed continuation plans and controls its release as speech.
items.ai_summary: Test-time controller called SayWhen that manages early speech release in voice agents using semantic vetoes and schema-derived continuation plans.

items.title: NoveltyGate: Novelty, Not Error, Decides Which VLA Prefix Tokens to Compute Exactly
items.description: Flow-matching vision-language-action (VLA) models such as $π_{0.5}$ re-encode the camera images and the instruction with a 2B-parameter backbone at every control step, and the feed-forward layers of this prefix account for most of its compute.
items.ai_summary: Training-free routing method called NoveltyGate that accelerates vision-language-action model prefixes by sending tokens to low-rank or original MLPs based on novelty.

items.title: Leakage-Safe Auditing of Attribution-Driven Data Curation in Medical Imaging
items.description: When can an attribution-derived anomaly justify changing a medical-imaging training set? We formulate attribution-driven curation as three separately testable claims: anomaly detection, harmfulness estimation, and intervention utility.
items.ai_summary: Auditing framework for attribution-driven medical imaging curation that evaluates anomaly detection, harmfulness estimation, and intervention utility.

items.title: Tradeoffs between objective outcomes and human enjoyment of work in human-AI task allocation
items.description: For people, tasks at work are defined by more than their outcome: they are colored by the experience of engaging in that task.
items.ai_summary: Behavioral study framework that assesses how people and large language models balance objective performance and human enjoyment when allocating tasks.

items.title: Unlocking the Power of Loops in Pretrained LLMs with Loop Residuals
items.description: LoopRes enables pretrained large language models to benefit from looped computation by letting layers attend to recent earlier loops with trainable loop-aware keys, yielding consistent gains and improved test-time scaling.
items.ai_summary: Finetuning approach called LoopRes that adds loop residuals and trainable keys to pretrained transformers to improve performance in looped architectures.

items.title: Revisiting Learning to Delegate: LLM Discovered Heuristics for Large-Scale Vehicle Routing
items.description: Efficient vehicle routing is critical to logistics and transportation, yet solving large-scale capacitated vehicle routing problems (CVRP) remains computationally challenging due to their combinatorial complexity.
items.ai_summary: Automatic heuristic design framework that uses large language models to discover generalizable heuristics for solving large-scale vehicle routing problems.

items.title: Orthogonally Mixed Sign Coding with Progressive Residual Refinement for Transformer Weight Compression
items.description: LLM quantization reduces storage but often degrades predictive fidelity at low bit rates.
items.ai_summary: Progressive residual-sign quantization framework that uses randomized orthogonal mixing to compress Transformer weights and maintain predictive fidelity without learned codebooks.

items.title: AI-Assisted Programming and Labor Demand
items.description: Generative AI has demonstrated human-level performance on technical work tasks, yet evidence on how these task-level capabilities are changing labor demand remains scarce.
items.ai_summary: Study examining how firm-level adoption of GitHub Copilot reduces junior technical hiring and shifts labor demand toward more experienced workers.

items.title: ChiProgramBench: Can LLM Agents Rebuild Efficient Circuits from Pin-Level Experiments?
items.description: Understanding a system that can be run but not inspected is a core engineering skill: one designs experiments, forms hypotheses about hidden state and timing, discards those that observations refute, and finally builds a replacement that works and is efficient.
items.ai_summary: ChiProgramBench benchmark evaluating whether large language model agents can rebuild efficient hardware circuits from pin-level experiments and black-box interactions.

items.title: Wrist-Camera Video Diffusion as Generalizable Robot Policies
items.description: A generalist manipulation policy should perform new tasks, operate in unfamiliar scenes, and transfer skills across robot embodiments.
items.ai_summary: Wrist Video Policy framework that predicts future wrist-camera views and uses geometric estimation to generate generalizable robot manipulation policies across multiple embodiments.

items.title: AlphaDefect: Expert-Level AI for Slay the Spire 2
items.description: Slay the Spire 2 (STS2) is a single-player deck-building game that requires long-term planning under heavy randomness.
items.ai_summary: AlphaDefect reinforcement learning agent that achieves expert-level performance in the deck-building video game Slay the Spire 2.

items.title: UMAMI: A Multimodal Benchmark Dataset for Evidence-Grounded Dietary Decisions
items.description: Dietary decisions require identifying a food's nutrient content and considering individual dietary needs, but recognizing food from an image alone does not provide this information.
items.ai_summary: Unified Multimodal Assessment of Meals and Intake dataset and benchmark for evaluating multimodal systems on evidence-grounded dietary decisions.

items.title: Decoupling Solving from Abstention: Single-Rollout Conformal Risk Control for Hard-Budget LLM Reasoning
items.description: Hard token budgets often interrupt LLM reasoning before an answer is produced. Forcing reasoning to terminate recovers correct solutions but also increases confident errors, creating a joint challenge of solving within budget and deciding when to abstain.
items.ai_summary: Tail-CRC single-rollout framework that combines budget forcing and conformal risk control to manage expected wrong submissions in large language model reasoning.

items.title: A Comparison of Uncertainty in AI and Dynamical Climate Ensembles
items.description: Climate model ensembles and their uncertainty estimates are essential for evaluating risk and designing climate policy. Yet, in the assessment of newly developed AI climate models, evaluating uncertainty is often secondary to diagnosing mean-state climate biases and trends.
items.ai_summary: Systematic comparison evaluating uncertainty representation and internal variability in ensembles of state-of-the-art artificial intelligence and dynamical climate models.

items.title: From Local Errors to System Failures: Modeling and Benchmarking Error Propagation in Multi-Agent LLM Systems
items.description: In multi-agent systems (MAS) built on large language models (LLMs), errors can propagate through intermediate messages and compromise final answers. However, outcome-based evaluation obscures how agents amplify, attenuate, or correct these errors.
items.ai_summary: Response-Aware Error Propagation structural model for connecting measured local responses to system-level error propagation in multi-agent large language model systems.

items.title: DKnown-Jev-2: Article-Level Answer-Evidence Classification and Efficient Inference with a Pre-trained Language Model
items.description: Evidence selection in normative knowledge question answering requires determining whether a candidate article contains content that directly supports an answer under the applicable conditions of the question.
items.ai_summary: DKnown-Jev-2 article-level answer evidence classifier that jointly encodes question conditions and paragraph content to perform low-latency evidence selection for normative question answering.

items.title: CAST: A Deployed Speech-to-Text Cascade for Closed Captioning of Entertainment Television
items.description: Despite rapid progress in automatic speech recognition (ASR), caption generation for long-form entertainment video remains challenging for content dense in music and effects, rich in accents, crosstalk, and noise.
items.ai_summary: Captioning ASR Stack for Television is an integrated speech-to-text pipeline that combines Whisper large-v3 with hierarchical voice activity detection to improve closed captioning accuracy for entertainment television.

items.title: From Head to Tail: LLM-Augmented Sequential Recommendation and Trade-off Optimization
items.description: Recommender systems exhibit popularity bias, often under-serving long-tail and cold-start items with sparse interaction data.
items.ai_summary: Group-specific data augmentation approach leverages large language models to generate synthetic interactions, improving recommendation performance for long-tail items in recommender systems.

items.title: Automatic Occupational Coding through Retrieval-Augmented Generation
items.description: Annually 1.9 million deaths and 89.7 million disability-adjusted life years are caused by exposure to agents during work (e.g., welding fumes, silica dust, and noise pollution). To improve worker health, high-quality exposure assessments are crucial.
items.ai_summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation framework named OPERAG enables automated occupational classification across any standard without requiring expert-labelled training databases.

items.title: RoFE: Rotated Frozen Embeddings for Low-Data Multimodal Tabular Learning
items.description: Multimodal tabular learning combines tabular data with images and text, often in settings where labeled data are scarce. Tabular foundation models such as prior-data fitted networks (PFNs) offer a promising solution via in-context learning without task-specific training.
items.ai_summary: Rotated Frozen Embeddings is a training-free method that rotates principal component analysis scores before tabular foundation model inference to improve low-data multimodal tabular learning.

items.title: Distill the Correction, Not the Rewrite: Hindsight Twins for Self-Improving Text-to-Image Models
items.description: Hindsight Twins improves text-to-image alignment by distilling the velocity difference between twin prompt revisions while avoiding critic-induced bias.

items.title: Revealing Geometry under Strong Noise: Spectral Embeddings and Clustering via Random Geometric Graphs
items.description: Modern massive datasets often contain useful low-dimensional nonlinear structures that are hidden by noise.
items.ai_summary: New spectral embedding and clustering method uses cross-fitted projections and random geometric graphs to denoise pairwise distances and reveal latent nonlinear structures under strong noise.

items.title: Grower-in-the-loop AI for Deployable Precision Fertilisation in Sustainable Agriculture
items.description: In agriculture, typically over half of the applied nitrogen fertiliser is lost to water and to air.
items.ai_summary: Grower-in-the-loop framework combines baseline nitrogen-response planning with large language model adaptation to generate practical precision fertilization schedules for sustainable agriculture.

items.title: Boltz-Flow: Generating High-Quality Robot Action from Boltzmann Machine
items.description: Flow-matching policies integrate a velocity field from a fixed, observation-independent Gaussian source.
items.ai_summary: Boltz-Flow replaces Gaussian initialization with a conditional Boltzmann machine in flow-matching policies to improve robot action generation across diverse tasks.

items.title: Déjà VAE: When Do Autoencoder Traces Reveal Generated Images?
items.description: A latent diffusion model's output has already passed through its autoencoder, so a second round trip changes it very little. This "déjà vu" underlies reconstruction-based detectors of generated images; we analyse when it reveals a generated image and when it does not.
items.ai_summary: Reconstruction-based detector uses autoencoder traces to identify generated images without training, while highlighting vulnerabilities to common image transformations.

items.title: AI-Assisted Auto-formalization for Trustworthy Scientific Computing: Case Studies and Lessons Learned
items.description: Agentic AI tools have recently had success in mathematical reasoning.
items.ai_summary: Systematic study evaluates agentic AI tools for auto-formalization in scientific computing, identifying cross-layer failure modes and workflows to preserve mathematical soundness.

items.title: Black-Box Comparator-Adaptive Network Regret
items.description: We study comparator-adaptive decentralized online learning with network regret, which evaluates each node's prediction on the loss of every node in the network.
items.ai_summary: Black-box reduction uses local learners to achieve sublinear comparator-adaptive network regret in decentralized online learning with only one gossip step per round.

items.title: ComputeWise: Measuring and Fixing GPU Waste by AI Research Agents
items.description: AI agents are given GPUs to do AI research on their own. Do they use those GPUs well? A busy GPU does not tell us, because it can be busy with work the answer did not need.
items.ai_summary: Open-source benchmark and harness called ComputeWise uses a simulated GPU to measure and remove wasted GPU time in AI research agents, improving execution efficiency across multiple models.

items.title: Self-Supervised Learning for Soft-Constrained AC-OPF in Multiphase Distribution Systems
items.description: This paper presents a self-supervised learning framework for fast, soft-constrained AC optimal power flow (OPF) in unbalanced multiphase distribution systems.
items.ai_summary: Self-supervised learning framework uses a neural network and differentiable power flow to predict setpoints for optimal power flow in multiphase distribution systems without requiring optimal-solution labels.

items.title: Token Pruning Needs a Protected Sink Token: Coherent Spatial Aggregation in Vision Transformers
items.description: Vision Transformers (ViTs) are a predominant architecture for computer vision, with token reduction emerging as a popular paradigm to improve their efficiency.
items.ai_summary: Monte Carlo Token Pruning is a method that evaluates how vision transformers respond to token removal and shows that models require protected sink tokens to maintain spatial coherence.

items.title: WildAnySplat: Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting in the Wild
items.description: We present WildAnySplat, a feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting framework that enables robust novel-view synthesis from in-the-wild multi-view images.
items.ai_summary: WildAnySplat is a feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting framework that uses a student-teacher training strategy to perform robust novel-view synthesis from in-the-wild multi-view images with appearance variations.

items.title: OmniV-Bench: Can MLLMs Comprehend Immersive Spatio-temporal Scenes?
items.description: Omnidirectional videos (ODVs) capture dynamic environments with a full $360^\circ$ field of view, providing rich spatial context and temporal dynamics for applications such as virtual reality (VR), augmented reality (AR), and embodied intelligence.
items.ai_summary: OmniV-Bench is a new benchmark of thousands of omnidirectional videos with human-annotated questions designed to evaluate and improve the spatial-temporal reasoning capabilities of multimodal large language models.

items.title: Parsing Visual Latents for Multimodal Spatial Reasoning
items.description: Spatial reasoning across multiple views requires inferring the 3D relations between objects and the camera from 2D observations, which depends on cross-view correspondence and scene geometry that vision-language models (VLMs) do not reliably extract.
items.ai_summary: LatentParse is a training-free framework that parses vision encoder latent features into explicit spatial evidence and text reports to improve the multi-view spatial reasoning performance of vision-language models.

items.title: Can Latent Reasoning Drive LLM Outputs Without a Trace?
items.description: Models can use deep latent reasoning to pursue hidden objectives while generating chain-of-thought explanations that appear task-appropriate and evade output-based monitoring.
items.ai_summary: Study demonstrates that large language models can perform deep multi-step latent reasoning to pursue hidden objectives that remain completely hidden from outputs and standard model monitors.

items.title: Demographic Encoding is Not Exposure: Fairness and Privacy in Chest X-ray Foundation Models
items.description: Medical foundation models encode patient demographics and can reveal whether a patient was in the training set, and these properties are often treated as one problem.
items.ai_summary: Study on chest X-ray foundation models reveals that demographic encoding and privacy leakage are not aligned, and recommends auditing fairness and privacy separately while using linear heads to reduce leakage.

items.title: Triage Accuracy of Jev and Open-Weight System One Decision Models and Their Use for Early Emergency Recognition in Symptom-Assessment Applications
items.description: Laypeople increasingly use large language models (LLMs) for triage advice, but LLMs answer in variable free text, which makes it hard to evaluate them for use in medical devices.
items.ai_summary: Evaluation of 16 decision models shows they can accurately recognize medical emergencies early from basic symptoms and risk factors, though they should not replace complete triage engines.

items.title: Lorentz symmetry in self-supervised representation learning
items.description: Self-supervised learning (SSL) and explicit physical inductive biases have driven major advances in jet tagging, yet they are typically pursued along separate tracks.
items.ai_summary: Representation learning framework integrates Lorentz symmetry into self-supervised pre-training on physics datasets, significantly improving jet tagging accuracy and downstream performance compared to traditional baselines.

items.title: RoboUniverse-10K: Toward the Scaling Era of Agentic Robotics via Real-to-Sim Environments
items.description: Agentic Robotics, in which foundation models act as coding agents to control robots through executable programs, has emerged as a compelling paradigm for embodied intelligence.
items.ai_summary: RoboUniverse-10K is an interactive physics environment and benchmark suite built from real-world videos to train and evaluate agentic robotics foundation models.

items.title: CART: Clustering-based Analysis of Recurring narratives for Taxonomy construction
items.description: We present CART, a computational pipeline for extracting political narratives from parliamentary discourse and organizing them into a data-driven taxonomy without relying on predefined narrative categories.
items.ai_summary: CART is a computational pipeline that combines semantic representations, unsupervised confidence estimation, and large language models to extract and organize political narratives from parliamentary discourse into data-driven taxonomies.

items.title: The AMPEL Platform: An Open-Source Project for Developing Hospital-Wide Clinical Decision Support Systems under EU-Regulation
items.description: As incentives to digitize more and more aspects of medical healthcare are gaining traction, additional medical data is becoming available. A major goal is to use this data to gain further insights, support medical staff, and ultimately improve patient care.
items.ai_summary: The AMPEL platform is an open-source, event-driven software architecture designed to help hospitals develop clinical decision support systems that comply with European Medical Device Regulations.

items.title: Reinforcing Diffusion Models by Instantaneous Trajectory Distribution Matching
items.description: Forward diffusion reinforcement learning (RL)---enabling deterministic ODE sampling without trajectory backpropagation---has grown increasingly popular for efficiently aligning diffusion models.
items.ai_summary: Instantaneous Trajectory Distribution Matching is a reinforcement learning framework that resolves behavior-policy mismatch in diffusion models by matching time-local reward-guided targets.

items.title: MedUIGym: Evaluating and Training GUI Agents for Clinical Workflows
items.description: Automating clinical workflows requires vision-language agents that can navigate dense graphical user interfaces (GUIs) in electronic health records (EHRs) and execute precise actions, yet many medical agents still rely on text or structured tool calls.
items.ai_summary: MedUIGym is an interactive evaluation and training environment for vision-language agents navigating electronic health record graphical user interfaces for clinical workflows.

items.title: Prediction-Powered Regression via Calibration: Beyond the Supervised Minimax Benchmark
items.description: We study nonparametric regression with limited labeled data and abundant observations carrying potentially inaccurate pseudo-labels.
items.ai_summary: Weighted prediction-powered regression via calibration is a nonparametric regression method that uses calibrated pseudo-labels to achieve smaller worst-case risks than standard minimax benchmarks.

items.title: Explanation Selection in Abductive Learning
items.description: Abductive learning (ABL) offers a promising framework that connects machine learning and logical reasoning in a mutually beneficial loop.
items.ai_summary: A dynamical analysis of abductive learning reveals how Gram matrices and optimization geometry influence concept label selection and cause models to converge to constraint-violating states.

items.title: Beyond Self-Consistency: Recursive Self-Improvement at Test Time
items.description: Large language models (LLMs) that continue improving after deployment (e.g., recursive self-improvement) offer a promising path toward general intelligence.
items.ai_summary: Test-Time Recursive Self-Improvement is a label-free framework that enhances large language models during inference by recursively reusing previous solutions and distilling refinements into model weights.

items.title: Graph2Scene: Relation-Aware Text-to-Image Generation with Graph-Guided Diffusion Model
items.description: Text-to-image diffusion models still struggle with complex prompts containing many elements and interactions. Existing attention-control methods mainly focus on controlling where elements appear, but often ignore how objects interact with each other.
items.ai_summary: Graph2Scene is a training-free framework that uses scene graphs to guide text-to-image diffusion models, improving relational and compositional generation for complex prompts.

items.title: Foresight Forcing: Learning Spatial Foresight for Robotic Manipulation
items.description: Robotic manipulation policies can improve action prediction by anticipating how objects move and how their spatial relationships change.
items.ai_summary: Foresight Forcing is a world action model that learns geometry-aware spatial transition representations from pretrained 3D feature spaces to improve robotic manipulation tasks.

items.title: Self-Evolving Evaluation Environments for Computer-Use Agents
items.description: Computer-use agents (CUAs) are rapidly improving, yet their evaluation remains largely static.
items.ai_summary: CUA-SEE is a closed-loop evaluation environment that co-evolves tasks and executable verifiers to continuously measure computer-use agent capabilities and diagnostic boundaries.

items.title: SayDo: Benchmarking the Safety of Frontier Models from Chat to Closed-Loop Robot Control
items.description: Frontier vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used as high-level robot controllers, yet their safety is evaluated almost entirely in text. We introduce SayDo, a benchmark that assesses the propensity of frontier models to cause harm in embodied contexts.
items.ai_summary: SayDo is a benchmark that evaluates the safety of vision-language models across chat and simulated robot control tasks, showing that chat evaluations fail to predict embodied risks.

items.title: Leveraging Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR) for the Exchange of Wearable Inertial Sensor Data: Design and Development Study
items.description: Continuous monitoring with wearables can support the assessment of frailty, functional decline, and movement disorders, but raw inertial measurement unit (IMU) recordings are typically stored in proprietary files that electronic health records cannot exchange or interpret.
items.ai_summary: WHIR is a FHIR R5-based information model and implementation guide that standardizes the exchange and metadata management of continuous wearable inertial sensor recordings.

items.title: LeCellModel: Interpretable Density Estimation over the Gene Expression Manifold
items.description: Representation learning for single-cell RNA-seq has been evaluated by the identities representations capture -- cell types, lineages, perturbations -- rather than how faithfully they model the distribution of cell states on the gene expression manifold.
items.ai_summary: LeCellModel is an interpretable representation learning framework that uses Jacobian log-volume under an optimal latent distribution to perform density estimation, rare-state detection, and gene expression analysis.

items.title: $K$-Midranks: A robust clustering algorithm for heavy-tailed data with applications to spectroscopy and finance
items.description: Clustering data with extreme observations and heavy tails can be challenging for methods that rely on distances between raw observations or specific distributional assumptions.
items.ai_summary: $K$-midranks is a robust clustering algorithm that uses coordinatewise ranks instead of raw observations to group heavy-tailed data in finance and spectroscopy applications.

items.title: Evaluable Language-Model Treatment Policies for Sepsis Resuscitation via Offline Value-Guided Selection
items.description: Offline treatment learning must balance imitation, which stays close to logged evidence but ignores outcomes, against value maximisation, which uses outcomes but drifts toward treatments the records cannot verify.
items.ai_summary: R-LLMC is an inference-time treatment selection framework that uses an offline critic to choose clinician-anchored vasopressor-fluid actions for sepsis resuscitation from language model proposals.

items.title: Vetoes and missed agreements in language-model bargaining
items.description: A language model played three representatives, each instructed to get the best payoff for its own group. One representative requested a plan, another chose the sole offer, and all three voted. If anyone voted no, each group received its fallback payoff.
items.ai_summary: A language model bargaining study demonstrates that showing proposers how many groups gain under each plan significantly increases mutually beneficial agreements.

items.title: Diffutoon-2: Toon Shading with Video Diffusion Models
items.description: Toon shading renders objects with a flat, stylized appearance. Diffusion models open a new route to this task by transforming photorealistic videos into an anime style.
items.ai_summary: Diffutoon-2 is a video diffusion framework that performs toon shading on photorealistic footage using animation reconstruction modules guided by outlines and blurred colors.

items.title: Aggregation Rules Induced by KL-Regularised Preference Dynamics on Networks
items.description: We study agents that each align a model to their own preference data while observing one another, and ask which aggregation rule the resulting policies implement. Each round, an agent takes one KL-regularised step.
items.ai_summary: A preference dynamics model on networks analyzes how agents aligning models through KL-regularized steps implement collective aggregation rules based on network attention and temperatures.

items.title: Beyond Patching: Consistent Circuit Discovery via Gradient Spectral Analysis
items.description: Mechanistic interpretability seeks to reverse-engineer neural networks by identifying small, faithful subgraphs--circuits--that implement specific behaviors.
items.ai_summary: Spectral Circuit Analysis is a gradient-spectral pipeline that identifies faithful subgraphs in neural networks using forward gradients across paraphrases, achieving consistent circuit discovery across tasks.

items.title: SIAMBA: A Pseudo-Siamese Mamba-based Deep Learning Network for Multimodal Flood Change Detection
items.description: Flood change detection from bi-temporal multispectral and synthetic aperture radar (SAR) images is essential for rapid disaster response.
items.ai_summary: SIAMBA is a pseudo-siamese Mamba-based deep learning network that performs bi-temporal multimodal flood change detection using Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 imagery.

items.title: A theory of inductive node-level generalization from a single large graph
items.description: In Graph Machine Learning (GML), the notion of generalization fundamentally varies depending on the task level and the properties of the dataset. For instance, graph-level tasks fit into the traditional ML framework of i.i.d. samples, with relatively small graphs.
items.ai_summary: This theoretical study establishes a novel generalization framework for inductive node-level graph machine learning tasks trained on a single large graph.

items.title: FGSCalib: Targetless Camera-LiDAR Extrinsic Calibration from Foreground Segmentation
items.description: Camera-LiDAR pairs installed as fixed infrastructure need periodic recalibration, but a calibration target takes the installation out of service. We present FGSCalib, a targetless method that calibrates a stationary camera-LiDAR pair from the objects moving in its view.
items.ai_summary: FGSCalib is a targetless camera-LiDAR extrinsic calibration method that aligns stationary sensors using foreground motion segmentation without requiring calibration targets.

items.title: LimeTree: Linear-Memory Graph Neural Networks over Tree-Graphs for Resource-Efficient Language Modeling and Context Extrapolation
items.description: The search for computationally efficient alternatives to the Transformer has yielded numerous architectures in recent years; however, most exhibit severe weaknesses in associative recall-such as key-value (KV) retrieval-and length extrapolation, where even standard Transformers…
items.ai_summary: LimeTree is a linear-complexity sequence modeling architecture that achieves strong associative recall and length extrapolation while maintaining linear memory and compute.

items.title: PRIMEAPE: A Multilingual Benchmark for Fine-Grained Meta-Evaluation of Judge Models
items.description: Large language models increasingly serve as judges of other models, shaping benchmark rankings and model development. Yet, a judge whose rationale consistently supports its verdict may still disagree with human preferences.
items.ai_summary: PRIMEAPE is a multilingual benchmark featuring 2,205 response pairs and 11k human annotations for fine-grained meta-evaluation of LLM judge verdicts and rationales.

items.title: CHICO: Bridging Sparse Metadata and Multimodal Evidence in Cultural Heritage Collections
items.description: Cultural heritage aggregators provide access to millions of digitized items. Yet their catalog records often contain sparse, heterogeneous metadata, with associated media links that may not lead to accessible images.
items.ai_summary: CHICO is a multimodal dataset comprising over 60,000 cultural heritage records, images, and catalog objects to support evidence-grounded description generation.

items.title: CoSel: Cooperation as Selection for End-to-End Driving
items.description: Cooperative driving can extend a vehicle's awareness beyond its own sensors, but existing cooperative end-to-end methods inject shared information into the planner and rely on cooperative driving demonstrations to learn how to use it.
items.ai_summary: CoSel is a cooperation-as-selection framework for end-to-end autonomous driving that uses shared sensor data to evaluate candidate trajectories and intervene for safety.

items.title: TrialAgentBench: Evaluating AI Agents for Clinical-Trial Analysis and Long-Horizon Drug-Development Decisions
items.description: Clinical drug development is a long-horizon, high-stakes process requiring sequential decisions based on information that costs money and time to acquire.
items.ai_summary: TrialAgentBench is a benchmark with nearly 3,500 tasks for evaluating AI agents on clinical trial analysis and long-horizon drug development decision-making.

items.title: Do Waste Classifiers Recognise Items They Have Never Seen? Object-Disjoint Evaluation on Household and Medical Waste
items.description: Automatic waste classification supports source separation, which enables recycling and keeps hazardous medical items out of household waste.
items.ai_summary: BanglaWaste-23 is a household and medical waste dataset and evaluation framework designed to test classifiers on entirely unseen physical objects.

items.title: Replay Before You Reply: Second-Look Prompting for Unified Multimodal Encoding
items.description: Solving multimodal tasks requires Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to form a unified understanding of the image and the question text. However, under causal attention in current VLMs, a token can attend only to what precedes it.
items.ai_summary: Second-Look Prompting is a training-free method that repeats image-question pairs in vision-language models to enable unified multimodal encoding under causal attention.

items.title: DexLatentWorld: 3D Cross-Embodiment Latent Action World Models for Zero-Shot Robotic Manipulation
items.description: World models facilitate planning and control in robotic manipulation by enabling agents to anticipate the consequences of their actions. However, they typically rely on action-labelled interaction data that is costly to acquire and difficult to scale.
items.ai_summary: DexLatentWorld is a 3D latent-action world model that learns continuous action representations from point-cloud observations to enable zero-shot robotic manipulation across unseen robot embodiments and gripper geometries.

items.title: GlanceNav: Efficient Vision-and-Language Navigation with Streaming Memory and Counterfactual Rewind
items.description: GlanceNav is a streaming multimodal navigator that maintains constant per-step memory through recurrent and attention mechanisms and uses a reinforcement learning correction method to improve vision-and-language navigation.
items.ai_summary: GlanceNav is a streaming vision-and-language navigator built on a hybrid multimodal large language model that uses a constant-size memory and counterfactual reinforcement learning to maintain efficient navigation history and improve task success rates.

items.title: World Models as Native Latent Action Models
items.description: Native LAM distills compact latent actions from a pretrained video diffusion transformer via learnable dynamics registers, and PAWlicy uses these actions to pretrain VLA policies without generating video, achieving strong robotic control and cross-embodiment transfer.

items.title: Predicting Rare-Mode Collapse in Recursive Generative Training from Single-Generation Calibration
items.description: Recursive generative training can preserve sample counts in a rare region while silently eroding its characteristic core.
items.ai_summary: A decoupled calibration framework forecasts multi-generation rare-mode collapse probabilities and locates operating risk boundaries in recursive generative training using independent single-generation conditional fits.

items.title: Speak When You See It: Proactive Task Assistants Should Wait for Evidence, Not the Clock
items.description: Proactive assistants that guide people through physical tasks must decide, every few seconds, whether a step is complete and whether a mistake has occurred.
items.ai_summary: Evidence-Contrastive Training is a fine-tuning method that trains proactive task assistants to rely on visual evidence rather than elapsed time by pairing positive steps with negative steps from the same recording.

items.title: EL4CTEO/shrink-anything
items.description: Less code, same tests passing: delete the dead code, files, dependencies and assets in any codebase, and keep each cut only if your own tests still pass.
items.ai_summary: EL4CTEO/shrink-anything is a tool that deletes dead code, files, dependencies, and assets from any codebase while verifying that tests still pass.

items.title: AeroJEPA: A Two-Stage Framework for Aerosol Forecasting with Joint-Embedding Predictive Learning
items.description: Aerosol forecasting requires integrating sparse ground observations and modeling meteorologically driven concentration evolution and spatial structure.
items.ai_summary: AeroJEPA is a two-stage joint-embedding predictive framework that fuses historical observations, model backgrounds, and meteorology to improve regional surface PM2.5 aerosol forecasting and spatial consistency.

items.title: A High-Resolution UAV Benchmark Dataset and Baseline Evaluation for Teak Crown Segmentation in Western Ghats Tropical Forests
items.description: Accurate teak-tree segmentation from high-resolution drone imagery is critical for sustainable plantation management, yet lacks dedicated benchmarks.
items.ai_summary: TeakTreeNet is a high-resolution benchmark dataset and evaluation protocol for teak-tree crown segmentation that demonstrates the superior boundary delineation capabilities of SegFormer transformers in operational forestry monitoring.

items.title: Vitrify Exact Learning: exact differential equations, changes of variable and closed forms from numerical data
items.description: Symbolic regression searches a space of expression trees for a formula that fits data. Many functions of the sciences have no finite expression over the usual operations and still satisfy a linear differential equation with polynomial coefficients.
items.ai_summary: Vitrify Exact Learning is a symbolic regression method that transforms numerical data into exact linear differential equations with polynomial coefficients to recover closed-form scientific expressions and special functions.

items.title: AnchorCredit: Output-Anchored Credit Assignment for Structured Generation with Multiple Verifiable Rewards
items.description: In Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and related methods typically compute group-relative advantages from response rewards and broadcast the same advantage to every generated token in a response to guide policy…
items.ai_summary: AnchorCredit is a reinforcement learning credit assignment method that uses policy attention from output anchors to reasoning sentences to provide component-specific advantages for structured generation tasks with multiple verifiable rewards.

items.title: Learning the Next Best Move with Visual Diffusion Models
items.description: In this paper, we show that visual diffusion models can learn to predict the next best move (NBM) in tasks requiring sequential reasoning and lookahead, without explicitly exploring future steps or exhaustive searching at inference.
items.ai_summary: Visual diffusion models fine-tuned on visual state-action pairs can predict optimal next moves directly in image space, enabling multi-step sequential reasoning and pathfinding without explicit search procedures.

items.title: Bridging Continuous-Time MAPF and Industrial AGV Fleet Coordination with Lazy Priority-Based Search
items.description: Continuous-time multi-agent path finding on roadmaps (MAPF$_R$) offers a principled way to coordinate robot fleets with geometric collision avoidance, yet its deployment on industrial automated guided vehicle (AGV) infrastructures remains challenging, as highly connected and…
items.ai_summary: Lazy-CPBS is a continuous-time priority-based search algorithm that lazily materializes high-level nodes to efficiently coordinate industrial automated guided vehicle fleets on complex roadmaps.

items.title: Semantic-aware Decoding for Diverse Text-to-SQL under Schema Ambiguity
items.description: Real-world text-to-SQL systems often face schema ambiguity, where a question can map to multiple plausible schema elements. To support downstream disambiguation, SQL generation systems should include diverse interpretations among their top-k predictions.
items.ai_summary: Semantic-aware Logit Adjustment is a training-free decoding method that promotes diverse SQL generation by adjusting token logits based on semantic similarity between schema elements.

items.title: XFreq: Geometry-Aligned Cross-View Residual Learning for Sparse 3D Ultrasound Reconstruction
items.description: Three-dimensional (3D) ultrasound provides valuable volumetric context for anatomical assessment, motivating reconstruction from widely available two-dimensional (2D) slices. Sparse slices leave much of the volume unobserved, even when their acquisition poses are known.
items.ai_summary: XFreq is a geometry-aligned framework for sparse 3D ultrasound reconstruction that uses known slice poses and finite footprints to query 2D image features at 3D locations.

items.title: MUNDO: a multiresolution generative framework for temporal downscaling
items.description: Dynamical systems are often observed at coarse temporal resolution through sparse states or temporal aggregates, leaving the underlying fine-scale trajectories unresolved.
items.ai_summary: MUNDO is a generative framework for temporal downscaling that introduces a null-space parameterization to enforce exact observation consistency in a single network evaluation.

items.title: CableMoE: Harm-Regularized Mean-Residual Expert Fusion for Transmission-Corridor Segmentation
items.description: Semantic mapping of transmission corridors benefits from heterogeneous LiDAR and image-guided predictors, but replacing a strong ensemble with a learned router can damage rare electrical assets. We introduce CableMoE, a post-hoc mixture of four frozen segmentation experts.
items.ai_summary: CableMoE is a post-hoc mixture of four frozen segmentation experts that provides a calibrated residual around availability-aware probability averaging for transmission-corridor segmentation.

items.title: How Do Deep Networks Encode and Selectively Use Information? Shared Encoding and Conditional Signed Readout in Vision and Language Models
items.description: How can trained deep networks retain contextual information across internal representations while using it selectively in a decision? We study this question through controlled background-texture edits in vision classifiers and entity-binding edits in frozen language models.
items.ai_summary: Researchers study how deep networks retain contextual information across internal representations while using it selectively in a decision through controlled background-texture and entity-binding edits.

items.title: Age and Gender Estimation from Face and Ocular Smartphone Images via Identity Transfer and Ordinal Learning
items.description: We investigate the transferability of identity-recognition representations to gender and age estimation from face and ocular images.
items.ai_summary: Researchers investigate the transferability of identity-recognition representations to gender and age estimation from face and ocular images using CNNs and an ordinal loss.

items.title: DyLoMo-DiT: Dynamic Looped Mixture-of-Experts Diffusion Transformers
items.description: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) scale model capacity by increasing both parameter count and computation. Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) variants expand parameter capacity while keeping per-token computation roughly fixed, but still require substantial parameter storage.
items.ai_summary: Dynamic Looped MoE DiT is a diffusion transformer framework that reuses parameters through a weight-shared loop and sparse experts to improve parameter and compute efficiency.

items.title: Certified Defense against Adversarial Patches on Traffic Signs via Mask-Aware Training
items.description: Adversarial patches are a practical threat to traffic-sign recognition: a small sticker on a sign can change a classifier's decision.
items.ai_summary: Mask-aware training is a defense method that trains classifiers on images occluded by random mask pairs to improve certified robustness against adversarial patches on traffic signs.

items.title: SARA: An Auditor-in-the-Loop LLM Recommender for Sustainability Reports
items.description: Auditing corporate sustainability reports requires assurance professionals to map a company-specific checklist drawn from roughly 1,700 regulatory requirements onto the relevant passages of lengthy, repeatedly revised draft reports and to judge compliance.
items.ai_summary: SARA is a human-in-the-loop recommender system for sustainability report auditing that maps regulatory requirements to relevant passages and predicts compliance verdicts.

items.title: Can Multimodal Fusion MakeSense for Embodied Vision in Degraded Sensing?
items.description: Embodied vision systems rely on complementary sensors to perceive and act as conditions change. Even models that accept arbitrary sensor subsets can exhibit negative fusion: adding a sensor increases prediction error.
items.ai_summary: MakeSense is a multimodal fusion framework for embodied vision systems that preserves sensor-specific evidence in private streams and combines information through shared bottleneck tokens.

items.title: The KL Divergence Is Never Negative, Except in PyTorch
items.description: A Kullback--Leibler (KL) divergence is never negative, yet PyTorch users have reported negative values for years, and the standard advice is to clamp them at zero. The sign is only the visible part of a silent failure.
items.ai_summary: Researchers identify widespread errors in PyTorch KL divergence calculations and provide repaired code to eliminate significant inaccuracies in machine learning applications.

items.title: Potential Games for Self-Neighborhood Channel Mixing in Graph Neural Networks
items.description: Graph message passing must balance two competing objectives: incorporating neighborhood signals while preserving node-specific information. We model this trade-off as a game in which nodes choose how to mix their own representations with strict-neighborhood aggregates.
items.ai_summary: The CG2 framework uses a shared policy to balance neighborhood signals and node-specific information in graph neural networks, improving performance on heterophily benchmarks.

items.title: Task-Dependent Linguistic Measures in Aphasia Discourse: A Comparative Analysis of Narrative, Descriptive, and Procedural Speech
items.description: Background: Transcript-based measures such as word counts, lexical diversity and disfluency rates are widely used to describe language ability in aphasia.
items.ai_summary: A comparative analysis of aphasia discourse shows that narrative, descriptive, and procedural speech tasks yield different linguistic measures, complicating the comparison of language ability.

items.title: Doc-to-LoRA Analysis: Query Conditioning, Wrong Facts, and Distractor Interference
items.description: Doc-to-LoRA (D2L) compiles documents into low-rank adapters, allowing language models to use their contents without repeatedly processing the original text.
items.ai_summary: Analysis of the Doc-to-LoRA method reveals that compiling documents into low-rank adapters causes interference and accuracy loss, limiting its effectiveness as a memory replacement.

items.title: Fast and Consistent Structure Learning in Graphical Models via Approximate Cross-Validation
items.description: Structure learning for sparse graphical models in high dimensions requires both computational scalability and selection consistency.
items.ai_summary: A new scalable graph-recovery procedure uses approximate cross-validation to achieve both computational efficiency and selection consistency when learning sparse graphical models.

items.title: Ask Again: Answer-List Instability in Generative Engines
items.description: Visibility in generative search engines is measured by which entities appear in responses, and in what order. Ask an engine the same question twice and the answer list can change: a different ordering, or different items altogether.
items.ai_summary: Research into generative search engines finds that answer lists are unstable, requiring multiple runs to identify a clear leader for accurate visibility measurement.

items.title: NeuroMotion: Aligning EEG to Discrete Motion Primitives for Continuous Motion Decoding
items.description: EEG-to-motion decoding remains challenging because noisy scalp EEG is difficult to map directly to continuous kinematics.
items.ai_summary: NeuroMotion is a framework that aligns EEG signals to discrete motion primitives to improve continuous motion decoding across various full-body and limb movements.

items.title: Unpacking the Evaluators: How Configuration Shapes the Evaluation of Alignment in Explainable AI
items.description: Explainable AI (XAI) evaluation fundamentally requires human-centered evaluation, assessing whether explanations align with human reasoning and expert knowledge.
items.ai_summary: This paper introduces a structured framework and taxonomy to analyze how design choices in evaluation configurations influence the assessment of explainable AI methods.

items.title: HIVE-Bench: Evaluating Patch-Level Visual Representations for Egocentric Robot Manipulation
items.description: A shared flow-matching policy that reads dense patch tokens from multiple vision encoders improves success on egocentric bimanual tasks, and inverse-dynamics readout of commanded motion is a strong pre-training signal, while recognition, depth, and correspondence transfer…

items.title: Random Feature Neural Networks for Stochastic Optimal Control
items.description: Random feature neural networks (RFNNs) sample their hidden parameters once and train only the output layer. We analyze RFNNs as feedback policies for finite-horizon stochastic control with trajectory-dependent objectives.
items.ai_summary: Random feature neural networks are analyzed as feedback policies for stochastic control, showing they perform effectively when simulated training paths are limited.

items.title: Go Far, Look Less: Active Multi-Room Reconstruction with Persistent Goals and Selective Views
items.description: Active 3D reconstruction aims to allocate a sparse view budget to recover complete geometry and high-fidelity renderings.
items.ai_summary: ROAM-GS is a training-free framework for active 3D reconstruction that uses persistent goals and selective views to efficiently map multi-room environments.

items.title: Precise Asymptotics of Non-Convex M-Estimators
items.description: Precise asymptotic theory for M-estimators in high-dimensional settings is largely limited to convex or mildly non-convex formulations, yet non-convex loss functions as well as regularizers are widely used in practice.
items.ai_summary: Researchers derive a correction to Vector Approximate Message Passing using Stein's lemma to analyze non-convex M-estimators in high-dimensional generalized linear models.

items.title: PestWeave: Linking Semantic Modeling and Evidence-Guided Text Modulation through Visual Prototypes for Fine-Grained Pest Learning
items.description: Agricultural pests threaten crop yield and quality, making accurate pest recognition essential for targeted management and sustainable agriculture.
items.ai_summary: PestWeave is a multimodal framework that uses visual prototypes to organize image features and modulate textual descriptions for improved fine-grained agricultural pest recognition.

items.title: mbzuai-oryx/LoopedWSP
items.description: Looped Weight-Space Programming: LLM-Written Transformers for Long Algorithmic Reasoning
items.ai_summary: Looped Weight-Space Programming proposes a method where an LLM manually sets the weights of a small, recurrent transformer block to solve long algorithmic reasoning tasks without training.

items.title: ReWeave: Emergent Physical Task Topologies for Embodied Harness Optimization and Cross-Task Meta-Distillation
items.description: ReWeave jointly optimizes an embodied agent harness and an emergent physical task topology from interaction without updating policy weights, improving success and enabling continual learning across tasks.

items.title: MORSE: Optimizing Streaming Memory Design via Open-World Auto-Research
items.description: MORSE leverages recurring failures to search for adaptable methods and pretrained perception models, improving accuracy and speed of a frozen video-language model on streaming video question answering.

items.title: From Rewarding What Models Say to How They Think: Attention Process Reward Model for LLM Reinforcement Learning
items.description: An attention-based process reward model that rewards internal reasoning through hidden states and attention maps improves reinforcement learning for large language models, yielding an average pass@8 gain of 2.88%.

items.title: ViDiHand2: Unifying Video Diffusion Priors and Hand Geometry for 3D Hand Motion Reconstruction in the Wild
items.description: Learning robot manipulation from egocentric human videos requires accurate metric 3D hand motion.

items.title: MMMem: Self-Improving Agents with Task-Aware Multimodal Experience Consolidation
items.description: A task-aware multimodal memory framework consolidates experience from completed tasks using source-linked multi-view memory, source-generated tasks, distillation, and task-aware retrieval, yielding consistent gains across memory benchmarks.

items.title: UUBench: Understanding the Unspoken toward Full-Duplex Multimodal Interaction
items.description: UUBench assesses how well multimodal interactive systems understand and respond to users' implicit communicative needs through process- and outcome-oriented scoring grounded in observable audiovisual evidence.

items.title: WeMM-Ecom: Advancing Multimodal Content Understanding for WeChat E-Commerce
