items.description: WeMM-Ecom, a family of multimodal large language models spanning dense and mixture-of-experts sizes, is trained with continued pre-training and hybrid-thinking post-training to achieve strong e-commerce and general-purpose results and is deployed in WeChat.

items.title: Embo-Harness: Towards Understanding Frontier-Model-as-Policy Harness
items.description: A systematic framework shows that frontier multimodal models can serve as robot policies when harnessed with interfaces favoring native visual reasoning and tool use, achieving high success in simulated and real manipulation tasks.

items.title: What Makes Good Data for Training Coding Agents? A Systematic Study on SWE-Gym
items.description: Auditing reward labels in coding-agent reinforcement learning tasks shows many unsolved tasks are mislabeled, and training on corrected tasks improves policy performance on SWE-bench benchmarks.

items.title: WorldLeague: Benchmarking Physical Agency
items.description: WorldLeague benchmarks 13 AI systems on 60 simulated robot tasks spanning exploration, rearrangement, and adaptation, measuring progress and success to compare autonomous physical goal achievement.

items.title: Write, Evolve, Read: Streaming Cameras into a Persistent World State for 4D Occupancy Forecasting
items.description: PersistWorld maintains a scene-anchored 3D world state updated from camera streams and forecasts future semantic occupancy more accurately and faster than prior camera-based world models.

items.title: GameDojo: Benchmarking Real-Time Interactive Agents in Video Games
items.description: GameDojo is a controllable benchmark of 120 boss encounters across 20 games with 600 hours of gameplay trajectories, showing frontier models struggle in real-time interaction while training GameDojo-4B achieves frontier performance and policy transfer across bosses.

items.title: A Pipeline-Parallel System for Depth-Recurrent Models
items.description: Loop-PP schedules cyclic pipeline stages for depth-recurrent models, overlapping communication and compute while preserving exact numerical equivalence, reducing memory and increasing throughput on MoE models.

items.title: SWEEP-Bench: Do Embodied Policies Act on the Speed They See?
items.description: A simulation benchmark shows that robot manipulation policies often fail at non-average conveyor speeds, while past frames or speed inputs improve models when speed is linearly decodable.

items.title: 3AGameFactory-Motion: Agentic Rigging and Reliable Complex Motion Generation for Diverse 3D Assets
items.description: A new benchmark evaluates rigging and motion generation across six 3D morphology categories, compares specialized, video-based, and agent-driven paradigms, and proposes an agentic framework that writes compact parametric skeleton and motion programs executed deterministically…

items.title: Motion Mamba 2.0: Autoregressive Diffusion Mamba for Long-Horizon Humanoid Control
items.description: Long-horizon, real-time controllable motion generation is essential for interactive animation and humanoid robotics, where an agent must respond to changing instructions and spatial goals while moving.

items.title: Wactorz: Self-Writing LLM Agents That Discover, Repair, and Migrate at the Edge
items.description: Most LLM agent frameworks build a crew that runs a task and exits. Physical environments (e.g., homes, labs, factory floors) need agents that stay up for months, survive their own bugs, and run on whatever hardware is already next to the sensors.

items.title: Polytropos: What Do Vision-Language Model Descriptions Make of a Cultural Object?
items.description: Vision-language models have become a new kind of describer, writing about almost anything people see, and their descriptions now shape how cultures are known by people and by other models.

items.title: The norm axiom and factor hyperfields
items.description: Touchard and the author asked whether every valued hyperfield, in Krasner's sense with the norm axiom, is of the form H_ρ(K): a valued field K read up to relative error ρ. The question turns on the norm axiom.

items.title: Beyond Attention Maps: Understanding and Improving Medical MLLMs via Visual Values
items.description: Paired non-contrast and contrast-enhanced medical images reveal that visual content retrieved through value vectors, rather than spatial attention alone, is critical for multimodal model perception, motivating a distillation method that improves non-contrast inference.

items.title: GameAnything: From Any Inspirations to Playable Game Worlds
items.description: An open-source agentic platform and benchmark enable iterative transformation of multimodal inspirations into playable game extensions, revealing that coding agents can adapt reference content but still struggle with playable interactions and precise modifications.

items.title: A Glimpse of Training VLMs as Foundation Models for Robotic Manipulation
items.description: nanoAstra combines semantic action modeling with capability-preserving supervised fine-tuning to train vision-language models for generalizable robot manipulation, achieving strong zero-shot success and faster streaming execution.

items.title: limi124/Geo-ML
items.description: Geo-ML｜地理人的机器学习课：多源栅格对齐、空间分块验证、树模型与 SHAP 解释（8 章 Jupyter Notebook 实战教程）
items.ai_summary: Open-source Python tutorial repository that teaches geospatial machine learning workflows, including multi-source raster alignment, spatial block cross-validation, and model interpretation using SHAP.

items.title: Lingximo/Lysmor
items.description: Self-hostable AI companion system: long-term memory, emotion/physiology, multi-UI (chat / video call / life panel / memory mind-map / 3D room), and disaster-recovery backup.
items.ai_summary: Self-hostable AI companion system featuring long-term memory, emotional states, multi-device interfaces, and recovery backup tools.

items.title: Open Vision Banana: An Open Framework for Unified Visual Perception through Generation in RGB Space
items.description: Vision Banana showed that a closed image generator, instruction-tuned to paint perception outputs as RGB images, becomes a generalist vision model. Does this carry over to open generators, and if not, what fails?

items.title: NoHairCache: Calibrate-Once KV Cache Eviction with One Power-Law Exponent
items.description: A unified power-law scoring rule for cache eviction calibrates one exponent per model and yields a method that improves language-model perplexity and preserves question-answering accuracy without dataset-specific tuning.

items.title: Seeing Right, Writing Wrong: Where Short Chain-of-Thought Breaks Spatial VQA
items.description: Asking a vision-language model (VLM) to think step by step often makes it worse at spatial questions, even though the image stays in context. We show that short chain-of-thought (CoT) turns a perception problem into a transcription problem.

items.title: Distilling Visual Agents from Limited Interaction Experience
items.description: A few selected interaction trajectories combined with on-policy distillation allow a small visual agent to transfer broadly and recover most of a larger teacher's performance with minimal online experience.

items.title: Self-WSP: Can Language Models Improve Themselves Through Weight-Space Programming?
items.description: Language models can edit their own neural network weights to improve task performance, though the resulting gains are poorly understood and sometimes matched by random search.

items.title: MemTensor/MemT-1.0-Pro
items.description: Text generation model from MemTensor. 31 downloads and 80 likes so far.

items.title: zou172866/Antigravity-agy-dart

items.ai_summary: Zou172866/Antigravity-agy-dart provides a Google Antigravity plugin that improves cache hits, keeps cache warm, protects context quotas, and saves tokens.

items.title: harry-brogrammer/cho-viet
items.description: Sứ mệnh: xây dựng nền tảng thương mại điện tử số 1 Đông Nam Á, phục vụ 600 triệu người dùng vào năm 2030, vận hành hoàn toàn bởi AI, không phụ thuộc vào con người. Tầm nhìn: mỗi người Việt đều được mua sắm trực tuyến mà không cần bất kỳ ai đọc code.
items.ai_summary: E-commerce platform developed entirely by a multi-agent AI system and designed to operate autonomously.

items.title: Feedback Shortcut: Speculative Decoding for Latent Feedback Transformers
items.description: Feedback Shortcut reduces speculative decoding errors caused by feeding top-layer hidden states back into Transformer inputs by aligning projected states and correcting drafts with predecessor states, preserving exact-decoding quality while accelerating decoding.

items.title: Composable Soft-Prompt Distillation of RL Experts: Toward Continual Post-Training
items.description: RL post-training typically produces domain experts that must then be consolidated into one model, and as new experts keep arriving, this consolidation becomes a continual process.

items.title: SAVIOR: Sample-efficient Adaptation of Vision-Language Models for OCR Representation
items.description: A sample-efficient curation method and a structure-aware layout metric enable a fine-tuned vision-language model to improve OCR on challenging financial document patterns, achieving high word recall and document question-answering F1.

items.title: AutoPILOT: A Visual Agent Harness for Real-Time Gameplay
items.description: A harness that lets multimodal foundation models emit primitive actions, open-loop macros, or closed-loop controllers improves real-time game performance and reduces API cost.

items.title: stancaedy10-glitch/GTA-6-Switch-Version--PC-Emulator-2026
items.description: GTA VI PC Installer hub for Grand Theft Auto 6 on Windows 10/11. Explore PC release updates, installation preparation, Rockstar Games Launcher setup, graphics optimization, system compatibility, and a step-by-step installation guide for the upcoming PC version.
items.ai_summary: Installation guide and resource hub for preparing Windows PCs for Grand Theft Auto VI.

items.title: kn0sti/agora-mesh
items.description: Connect coding agents across your machines so they plan together, split the work, and push to separate git branches. Independent community project.
items.ai_summary: Community project that connects coding agents across different machines to collaboratively plan, split tasks, and push to separate git branches.

items.title: Xiangyfff/diff-review-agent
items.description: 基于大模型的多阶段代码审查 Agent 智能体。

items.title: inclusionAI/LingSante-3.1-air-VL

items.title: SynthDCB: World Distillation for Scalable Device Control Benchmarking
items.description: Scaling device-control evaluation requires scaling both interactive worlds and the tasks agents must solve. We introduce SynthDCB, a benchmark for environment awareness and device control built through world distillation (WD).

items.title: MomentMem: Memorizing Key Moments for Robot Manipulation
items.description: A hierarchical memory system using a vision-language model to select keyframes and an executor to act on them improves long-horizon robotic manipulation by retaining sparse visual details.

items.title: DiLE: Discrimination-Aware Latent-Space Learning for Universal Multimodal Embeddings
items.description: A discrimination-aware latent-space learning framework combines task guidance with on-policy retrieval feedback to preserve discriminative evidence in multimodal embeddings and improve retrieval across modalities and tasks.

items.title: UniVEP: Unifying Velocity and Endpoint Prediction for Robot Manipulation
items.description: UniVEP combines endpoint and velocity prediction with consistency supervision and switches from endpoint recovery to velocity refinement as noise decreases, improving success and efficiency in few-step robot action generation.

items.title: Fast-JEPA: Advancing the Success-Latency Frontier for Latent World Models
items.description: Fast-JEPA is a latent world model planning framework that improves the success-latency trade-off of predictive search by predicting complete action-sequence outcomes and using goal-directed plans, with evaluation on manipulation and navigation tasks and a new dynamic planning…

items.title: WeightCode: Installing New Capabilities into Neural Networks via Weight-Space Programming
items.description: Neural networks encode learned capabilities in their weights, yet extending those capabilities with explicit task knowledge remains a fundamental challenge.

items.title: Voice Isolator
items.description: Remove background noise from speech, from files or live
items.ai_summary: Tool for removing background noise from speech using uploaded files or live audio input.

items.title: How Complete Must an Environment Be to Train a Capable GUI Agent?
items.description: Graphical user interface (GUI) agents are widely trained in executable GUI environments. To lower cost, build environments in batches, and reduce manual effort, each work trades away part of the environment through its construction choices.

items.title: Seeing the Invisible: How Vision-Language Models Read, Predict and Trace Radio Fields
items.description: Operating in the physical world requires reasoning beyond what cameras directly capture. In a city, radio signals are invisible to the lens, yet their strength is governed by the buildings and streets an image does show.

items.description: Take-home assessment for early-career Machine Learning Engineers (0 to 2 years of experience) at OneCredit.

items.description: Optimized floating-point inference is not reproducible across environments: the same model on different hardware, compilers or thread counts can produce different bits.

items.description: How Greptile uses GPT-6 Astra to test user workflows, Daybreak to strengthen security, and Codex to reduce rework.

items.title: Working with academic communities to build scientific understanding
items.description: OpenAI shares model results on the Kakeya conjecture, Exponential Time Hypothesis, and quantum chromodynamics—and how researchers can verify and build on them.
items.ai_summary: OpenAI shares model results on specific mathematical and scientific conjectures to help researchers verify and build upon findings in academic communities.
