items.ai_summary: Deterministic agnostic PAC learner uses optimal sample complexity to return a total concept satisfying error bounds for partial concept classes of finite VC dimension.

items.title: DiTraR: Diverse Scorers and Transcript-Guided Re-ranking for Video Corpus Moment Retrieval
items.description: Video corpus moment retrieval asks a system to find, in a large collection of untrimmed videos with subtitles, the video and the time interval that a natural-language query describes.
items.ai_summary: DiTraR is a video corpus moment retrieval framework that uses diverse scorers, multi-scorer energy ensembles, and a transcript verifier to improve video selection and moment re-ranking.

items.title: BioEmu2: Scalable Emulation of Biomolecular Dynamics
items.description: Despite major advances in structure prediction, modelling the motions and interactions that drive biomolecular function at scale remains a central challenge.
items.ai_summary: BioEmu2 is a generative biomolecular dynamics model that combines static structure prediction, equilibrium sampling, and time evolution to simulate multi-component systems significantly faster than molecular dynamics.

items.title: ESSI: Computationally Efficient Semantic Search for Sparse Autoencoder Concepts
items.description: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) decompose diffusion model activations into interpretable features, but steering a model with them requires identifying which features map to a given semantic concept, if any.
items.ai_summary: Efficient Semantic Sparse Identification is a computationally efficient method that uses segmentation masks and binary search to identify and rank sparse autoencoder features for semantic model steering.

items.title: SUAF: Spectral Universal Advantage Features for Zero-Shot Policy Improvement
items.description: Reward-independent representations enable reinforcement learning agents to reuse knowledge across tasks, but limited representation capacity raises three fundamental questions: what statistical dependence should these representations capture, which components of that dependence…
items.ai_summary: Spectral Universal Advantage Features are paired features derived from canonical dependence analysis that enable reward-free data reuse and zero-shot policy improvement in reinforcement learning.

items.title: Augmentation of cardiovascular flow measurements with generative diffusion models
items.description: Cardiovascular imaging offers several ways to measure blood flow, but each provides an incomplete, resolution-limited, or noisy view of the underlying dynamics.
items.ai_summary: Generative diffusion models reconstruct missing information in cardiovascular flow measurements by generating plausible probabilistic ensembles of velocity and gradient fluctuations from limited observations.

items.title: StereoVLM: Binocular Vision-Language Models for Metric 3D Spatial Reasoning
items.description: StereoVLM is a geometry-aware binocular vision-language model trained with hierarchical supervision from calibrated stereo to enable metric 3D spatial reasoning, evaluated by Stereo3D-Bench.

items.title: Star Panoptic Quality: Selectively Evaluating Split and Merged Instances
items.description: Detecting individual instances is crucial for many segmentation problems.
items.ai_summary: Star Panoptic Quality is a novel evaluation framework that isolates and weights failure modes in instance segmentation, enabling practitioners to account for instance delineation biases.

items.title: Functional Depth Is Learned: Isolating the Computation That Layers Produce Only Together
items.description: Transformer performance scales with depth, but layer count merely counts the opportunities for sequential computation: layers could still behave as nearly independent refinements that barely depend on one another.
items.ai_summary: An exact inclusion-exclusion decomposition method tracks how transformers develop functional depth during pretraining, revealing that cross-layer dependencies strengthen and become behaviorally consequential over time.

items.title: Decision Columns as an Index: Interpretable Embeddings for Explainable Entity Matching and Search
items.description: Business data systems must determine whether records refer to the same entity and retrieve records satisfying requests whose decisive properties are implicit. As agents act on these records, both tasks require auditable reasons.
items.ai_summary: Interpretable embeddings built from decision columns enable explainable entity matching and search by storing calibrated answers to natural-language questions, decomposing similarity into per-question contributions.

items.title: AnimalFarm: Auditing the Generation and Detection of Hateful Images Featuring Anthropomorphic Characters
items.description: Anthropomorphic non-human characters have long been used to convey hateful messages targeting human groups, from Nazi-era propaganda to recent AI-generated imagery on social media. However, the safety risks posed by such imagery remain largely unexplored.
items.ai_summary: A systematic study and benchmark of hateful image generation and detection involving anthropomorphic characters reveals severe safety gaps in current AI models and detectors.

items.title: QuantStream3D: Geometry-Aligned Low-Bit KV Cache Quantization for Streaming Visual Geometry Transformers
items.description: Streaming visual geometry transformers retain historical key-value (KV) states as cross-view geometric memory, but growing caches constrain long-sequence inference.
items.ai_summary: QuantStream3D is a geometry-aligned low-bit key-value cache quantization framework for streaming visual geometry transformers that protects sensitive cross-view evidence and improves reconstruction quality.

items.title: Communication-Efficient Federated Learning of Latent Patient Representations from Multi-Institutional EHRs
items.description: Electronic health records (EHRs) contain rich health information for uncovering latent patient representations and clinically meaningful subgroups.
items.ai_summary: A communication-efficient federated spectral method learns shared latent patient representations from multi-institutional electronic health records while keeping patient-level data local and private.

items.title: The Dual-Tier Sentiment Framework: Scalable Multimodal UX Attribution in Web Search
items.description: Sustaining user experience (UX) quality in large-scale web search requires scalable evaluation. Traditional surveys are slow and bottleneck rapid A/B testing, while automated metrics often lack the granularity to diagnose visual-spatial UX anomalies.
items.ai_summary: The Dual-Tier Sentiment Framework is an industrial architecture combining fine-tuned and multimodal large language models to automate user experience regression detection and visual diagnostic attribution.

items.title: TEA-Bench-BR: Can Coding Agents Turn a Branching Clinical Specification into Correct Code?
items.description: Coding agents increasingly implement rules written by domain experts, and bugs in such code are silent: it runs and returns a plausible answer.
items.ai_summary: TEA-Bench-BR is a benchmark based on early autism screening pathways designed to test whether coding agents can accurately translate complex branching clinical specifications into correct code.

items.title: FairITR: Fairness-Aware Learning of Multicategory Individualized Treatment Rules
items.description: Individualized treatment rules (ITRs) recommend treatment decisions based on individual characteristics and can improve treatment outcomes beyond traditional one-size-fits-all strategies.
items.ai_summary: FairITR is a fairness-aware learning framework for multicategory individualized treatment rules that integrates adversarial learning and covariance-based regularization to optimize both treatment outcomes and decision fairness.

items.title: Speculative Decoding Is Less Speculative Than You Think
items.description: Speculative decoding accelerates language-model inference by preparing candidate continuations before the target model generates them. Its efficiency depends on how well limited drafting computation anticipates the path the target will actually follow.
items.ai_summary: Draw-Informed Candidate Selection is a speculative decoding method that pre-samples and synchronizes verification randomness to accelerate language-model inference without altering the target sampling distribution.

items.title: Renormalized Entropy from Symmetries: Simplicity Bias and Neural Heat Death
items.description: Neural networks have parameter symmetries: parameter transformations that do not affect the represented function. How do these symmetries affect the functions that neural networks ultimately learn?
items.ai_summary: Researchers study the implicit bias of neural network parameter symmetries, finding that an entropy term derived at positive temperature can cause a preference for low-rank functions or neural heat death.

items.title: Interpretable Tissue Architecture Complements Pathology Foundation Models
items.description: Tissue architecture provides important information for histopathological assessment, yet its complementary predictive value alongside pathology foundation-model representations remains insufficiently understood.
items.ai_summary: A study introduces a 139-dimensional cellular-to-community tissue representation that, when fused with pathology foundation models, improves classification performance on breast cancer and lung histopathology datasets.

items.title: LesionAgent: Training-Free Agentic Tumor Tracking and Response Assessment in Longitudinal CT
items.description: Every few months, a cancer patient's CT scans decide whether treatment continues. 3D foundation models can now detect, segment, register and track lesions, yet none of them reads the scans as a radiologist does.
items.ai_summary: LesionAgent is an LLM-powered agent that uses frozen 3D models to perform longitudinal CT tumor tracking and response assessment without task-specific training.

items.title: From Gist to Verbatim: The Controllable Path of One Image Through a Diffusion Prior
items.description: Modern generative models are typically studied for their ability to generalize, while memorization is treated as a failure mode. We invert this perspective and ask how a generative model can recall a single datum.
items.ai_summary: Researchers explore how generative models recall single images, showing that memory transitions from abstract semantic representation to exact verbatim reproduction during training.

items.title: Beyond Visual Fidelity: Comparing Categorical and Continuous World Models
items.description: Visual world models can now generate compelling interactive worlds, but visual realism does not guarantee faithful dynamics. We systematically compare how categorical and continuous prediction shape learned dynamics under both next-token and iterative whole-frame generation.
items.ai_summary: A study compares categorical and continuous prediction in visual world models, demonstrating that categorical models achieve higher rollout validity and long-horizon performance with less training compute.

items.title: Integrating Generative Artificial Intelligence with Learning Style Models: Opportunities, Challenges, and Future Directions
items.description: Generative Artificial Intelligence (Generative AI) has emerged as a powerful tool for transforming learning.
items.ai_summary: A review examines how generative artificial intelligence integrates with established learning style models to support student engagement in large online classes.

items.title: SLICR: Strategy Logic-Guided Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
items.description: Specification-guided reinforcement learning (RL) translates formal specifications of desired behavior of agents into shaped rewards.
items.ai_summary: SLICR is a multi-agent reinforcement learning framework that uses Strategy Logic and linear temporal logic to handle adversarial settings under partial observability.

items.title: OpenAHBU: Open-sourced Automatic Human Behaviour Understanding Toolkit Through Facial Behaviour Analysis
items.description: Automatic facial behaviour understanding (AFBU) is fundamental to various human-centred applications, yet existing academically available toolkits offer limited functionality, closed training pipelines, and weak generalisation.
items.ai_summary: OpenAHBU is an open-source toolkit integrating eleven facial behavior understanding functions across three semantic levels to analyze short-term attributes and psychological states and traits.

items.title: Who Grades the Agent? Privilege Separation for Coding-Agent Benchmarks
items.description: Benchmarks for AI-based coding agents are a staple of the current AI landscape, because they are the leading way to measure the performance of LLMs. Their scores guide business and research decisions.
items.ai_summary: SplitBench is a privilege separation framework for evaluating coding agents that isolates test execution from result judging to prevent agents from manipulating evaluation infrastructure.

items.title: ENC-QA: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Vision-Language Models on Electronic Navigational Charts
items.description: Nautical charts encode safety-critical maritime information through standardized symbols, attributes, text, and heterogeneous geometries.
items.ai_summary: ENC-QA is a diagnostic benchmark comprising over 77,000 questions derived from electronic navigational charts to evaluate vision-language models on nautical feature recognition and spatial reasoning.

items.title: Anchors That Move Without Collapsing: Exclusive-Region Anchor Routing for Vision Transformers
items.description: Anchor tokens let a vision transformer exchange global information through a few summaries, but nothing forces different anchors to summarise different things.
items.ai_summary: Exclusive-region anchor routing for vision transformers proposes hard exclusive patch assignments that improve accuracy and efficiency by preventing anchor collapse.

items.title: DGC-Net: A Depth-Geometric Conditioning Network for Projection-Supervised OCTA Segmentation
items.description: OCTA segmentation is commonly formulated as a projection supervised task: models observe 3D volumetric scans but are supervised by 2D en-face semantic maps.
items.ai_summary: Depth-Geometric Conditioning Network (DGC-Net) recasts 3D-to-2D optical coherence tomography angiography segmentation using depth-moment conditioning and holistic depth-geometry modulation to achieve state-of-the-art mIoU performance.

items.title: Beyond Self-Critique: Epistemic Convergence Control for Multi-Agent Research Verification
items.description: Multi-agent systems for scientific claim verification increasingly rely on role-structured LLM debate to pressure-test hypotheses.
items.ai_summary: A multi-agent research verification framework utilizes an asymmetric role architecture and belief-delta convergence criterion to cut LLM calls and reduce over-iteration while grounding claims in verified literature snippets.

items.title: Auditable Financial Knowledge Graphs: Schema-Driven Construction and Intrinsic Quality Evaluation
items.description: Financial documents combine narrative disclosures, accounting metrics, corporate structures, management commentary, and time-dependent facts, making them difficult to represent using conventional chunk-based retrieval-augmented generation systems.
items.ai_summary: An auditable financial knowledge graph construction methodology uses schema-driven phased extraction and fine-grained provenance to parse temporal financial documents into traceable knowledge graphs.

items.title: DistDNA: Language Model Fingerprinting under Stochastic Decoding
items.description: Behavioral fingerprints identify a large language model (LLM) from its responses to a shared set of prompts, enabling applications such as verifying whether a deployed model corresponds to the checkpoint it claims to be.
items.ai_summary: DistDNA represents large language models by their prompt-conditional response distributions and compares them using maximum mean discrepancy to identify model checkpoints under stochastic decoding without a classifier.

items.title: Graph Signal Generation via Graph-Aware Diffusion Models
items.description: Many signals are defined on the nodes of a graph, such as traffic flow at road sensors or user purchases of related products. They are often partly observed, and learning their distribution enables imputing missing values and forecasting future ones.
items.ai_summary: Graph-aware diffusion with mode-adaptive SNR scheduling improves graph signal imputation, forecasting, and recommendation accuracy by driving forward noise with heat diffusion on the graph.

items.title: Mixture of Latent Recursions for Low-Rank Adaptation
items.description: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) performs task-specific adaptation using a fixed low-rank architecture, whose expressiveness is typically increased by enlarging or adding learnable modules with a proportional parameter overhead.
items.ai_summary: Mixture of Latent Recursions (MoLR) recursively refines down-projected latent representations using a shared transformation and a lightweight router to enhance low-rank adaptation expressiveness with minimal parameter overhead.

items.title: Underwater Spectral Recovery via Multi-View Hyperspectral Imaging
items.description: Underwater imaging suffers from wavelength-dependent absorption and scattering that distort scenes and obscure spectral signatures. While RGB restoration improves visual clarity, the outputs remain broadband and tied to the sensor's color space.
items.ai_summary: A physically grounded framework uses multi-view hyperspectral imaging and low-rank basis functions to lift underwater restoration to continuous spectral radiance by jointly constraining scene radiance and water parameters.

items.title: Sampling non-abelian lattice gauge theories with diffusion models
items.description: We present gauge-equivariant diffusion models as samplers for lattice gauge theories (LGTs).
items.ai_summary: Gauge-equivariant diffusion models utilize lattice gauge-equivariant convolutional neural networks and the Metropolis-adjusted annealed Langevin algorithm to accurately sample two-dimensional U(2) and four-dimensional SU(3) lattice gauge theories.

items.title: Autonomous quantum machine learning via Riemannian gradient-based optimization
items.description: Quantum machine learning models typically rely on repeated quantum measurements and classical optimization during training, making the quantum-to-classical information-extraction process a fundamental bottleneck for scalability.
items.ai_summary: A framework for autonomous self-training quantum machine learning uses Riemannian gradient optimization entirely within the quantum domain to remove the classical optimization loop, provide exponential convergence guarantees, and automatically discover hidden symmetries.

items.title: Redesigning Neural Networks to Not be Confidently Wrong even to Strong Adversarial Attacks
items.description: Early deep learning models attempted to simulate visual perception using a neural hierarchy that alternated between two types of layer: one modelled on cortical simple cells (that was designed to increase selectivity), and one modelled on cortical complex cells (that aimed to…
items.ai_summary: Shallow neural network architecture that reduces false high-confidence predictions on unknown classes or noise, improving alignment with human visual perception and enabling accurate identification of adversarial samples.

items.title: SLP-Bench: Evaluating and Improving Acoustic Claims of Reasoning Audio Language Models on Clinical Speech
items.description: Audio language models (ALMs) can answer clinical questions from speech, outperforming baselines built on handcrafted acoustic features. Reasoning ALMs generate a chain of thought that refers to properties of the speaker's voice before predicting.
items.ai_summary: Speech Language Pathologist Bench is a benchmark that grades acoustic claims in audio language models' chains of thought against clinician ratings across five datasets and 25 perceptual dimensions.

items.title: DOiT: Better Money-Flow Ranking Can Coexist with Worse Account Selection in Anti-Money Laundering Review
items.description: Anti-money laundering (AML) review selects suspicious accounts and reconstructs transfers. Downstream graph neural networks (GNNs) rank money-flow evidence but may also reorder the account queue.
items.ai_summary: DOiT separates account selection and money-flow ranking decisions in anti-money laundering review, protecting upstream order while retaining graph neural network analysis where supported by evidence.

items.title: $\mathtt{DistP}$: Scaling Local-Update Training with Zero-Shot Hyperparameter Transfer
items.description: Local-update methods offer a communication-efficient alternative to Distributed Data Parallelism ($\mathtt{DDP}$), but introduce additional hyperparameters that require costly tuning.
items.ai_summary: DistP is a theoretical framework that extends zero-shot hyperparameter transfer to local-update training with varying worker counts, local steps, and outer optimizers, improving model quality and reducing validation loss.

items.title: Evaluating Prompting Strategies for Zero-Shot Multilingual Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis with Large Language Models
items.description: While large language models (LLMs) have advanced natural language understanding, their ability to perform complex target-aspect-sentiment detection (TASD) -- a key task within aspect-based sentiment analysis (ABSA) -- in zero-shot multilingual settings remains underexplored.
items.ai_summary: Systematic evaluation of zero-shot multilingual target-aspect-sentiment detection across 12 languages and three domains using seven open-weight models under four prompting paradigms.

items.title: Refrain: Learning Multi-Shot Consistency from Inconsistent References for A$^2$O Video Generation
items.description: A comic-book character, a photorealistic cityscape, an oil-painted coffee cup -- such stylistically diverse references provide visual guidance across shots and frames, yet generating a coherent multi-shot video that unifies their visual styles while preserving subject…
items.ai_summary: Refrain is a unified video generation model that learns cross-shot consistency through a self-supervised reconstruction task, mapping image and video references onto a shared temporal canvas without auxiliary conditioning modules.

items.title: ChildAI-Gov: An Evidence-Linked AI System for Assessing EdTech Policies Against Children's Digital Rights
items.description: We present ChildAI-Gov, an explainable AI system for assessing whether education-technology (EdTech) policies respect children's digital rights.
items.ai_summary: ChildAI-Gov is an explainable AI system that assesses whether education-technology policies respect children's digital rights by combining large-language-model judgments with deterministic rule checks and retrieval-augmented generation.

items.title: $\varepsilon$-SegFormer: Multi-Resolution Vision Transformers for Sparsely Supervised Segmentation in Electron Microscopy
items.description: Segmenting organelles in electron microscopy (EM) volumes requires dense annotations that take experts months to produce, and every gain in imaging resolution adds to this cost.
items.ai_summary: varepsilon-SegFormer is a multi-resolution Vision Transformer for sparsely supervised semantic segmentation in electron microscopy that samples views at three physical resolutions and encodes token positions in a shared frame.

items.title: Energy-preserving Bayesian model reduction: closed-form structured posteriors and probabilistic stability certificates for quadratic operator inference
items.description: Bayesian operator inference learns reduced-order models (ROMs) with polynomial structure from state data and returns a closed-form Gaussian posterior over the reduced operators.
items.ai_summary: Energy-preserving Bayesian model reduction framework that imposes energy preservation of quadratic operators as linear equality constraints within Bayesian operator inference to yield closed-form structured posteriors and probabilistic stability certificates.

items.title: Feasibility of Multifrequency Neural Network-Based Wave Inversion in Ultrasound Time-Harmonic Elastography
items.description: Ultrasound time-harmonic elastography (THE) is a non-invasive imaging technique that measures soft-tissue stiffness.
items.ai_summary: Study investigating the feasibility of adapting the MF-ElastoNet multifrequency neural network-based wave reconstruction method from magnetic resonance elastography to ultrasound time-harmonic elastography for soft-tissue stiffness mapping.

items.title: When Does Looking Closer Pay Off? Simple Foveated ViTs for Fine-Grained Recognition
items.description: Fine-grained recognition benefits from high resolution, but not every image region needs it. We study a foveated Vision Transformer (FoVT) that uses last-block class attention from a 224-pixel glance to select regions for refinement.
items.ai_summary: Vision Transformer model that uses class attention from a low-resolution glance to select image regions for high-resolution refinement, saving transformer operations for fine-grained recognition tasks.

items.title: Neural Defend ARCAS 290M: A Robust Foundation Model for AI-Generated Audio Detection
items.description: Voice cloning now needs only seconds of audio, and detectors tuned to one dataset often fail when the generator, channel, or language changes. We introduce ARCAS 290M, Neural Defend's foundation model for detecting AI-generated audio.
items.ai_summary: Neural Defend ARCAS 290M is an AI-generated audio detection foundation model that generalizes across various text-to-speech, voice-conversion, and channel conditions for fraud prevention and media verification.

items.title: A Benchmark Protocol and Fairness Analysis Towards Open-Set EEG Seizure Type Classification
items.description: Automated EEG seizure type classification systems are typically trained and evaluated under the closed-set assumption, where all seizure types encountered at deployment are seen during training.
items.ai_summary: Benchmark protocol and open-set recognition methods for automated EEG seizure type classification that evaluate performance when encountering rare or atypical seizure types outside the training data.

items.title: Search-RSI: Expanding Search Worlds Along Multimodal Agents' Capability Frontier
items.description: Multimodal search agents answer knowledge intensive visual questions by grounding them in retrieved evidence, and recent recipes train them on multi hop tasks that are synthesized from knowledge graphs and grown online to keep pace with the agent.
items.ai_summary: Search-RSI is a recursive self-improvement framework that expands the search world along a multimodal agent's capability frontier to improve performance on knowledge-intensive visual question answering.

items.title: QuASAR: Toward an LLM-Assisted Framework for Screening, Prototyping, and Assessing Quantum-Advantage Opportunities in Scientific Computing
items.description: Identifying scientific computations that could benefit from quantum algorithms requires both domain knowledge and fluency in quantum algorithm design, expertise that rarely resides in one person.
items.ai_summary: QuASAR is an LLM-driven pipeline that screens scientific literature for computational kernels with quantum-algorithmic analogues, builds prototypes, and benchmarks them against classical baselines.

items.title: Enhancing Attention with Higher-Order Attention
items.description: Current decoder large language models rely on a combination of attention, feed forward and residual layers. The attention used is autoregressive (AR) though this is not strictly correct, as we note.
items.ai_summary: Higher-order attention methods use conditional mutual information and generalized maximum entropy principles to enhance the information content of autoregressive probabilities in decoder language models.

items.title: From Novel Combinations to Informative Absence: Structural permission, communicative opportunity, and form choice in language learning
items.description: Language learners must infer which novel expressions are grammatically licensed and when continued absence is evidence against them.
items.ai_summary: Generative theory of language learning that decomposes utterance generation into structural permission, communicative opportunity, and form choice to model how learners infer grammatical expressions and negative evidence.

items.title: DPMA: Learning to Compress Mixture-of-Experts Models
items.description: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures offer high computational efficiency, but storing all experts requires substantial memory and limits deployment on resource-constrained hardware.
items.ai_summary: DPMA is a differentiable compression method for Mixture-of-Experts models that jointly learns to prune, merge, and absorb experts through gradient descent under a global budget.

items.title: Ref-YOLO-World: Decoupling Text-Side Computation for Efficient Referring Expression Comprehension on Edge Devices
items.description: Many high-accuracy referring expression comprehension (REC) methods produce image-dependent multimodal representations. These representations must be recomputed for every video frame, even when the referring expression remains unchanged.
items.ai_summary: Ref-YOLO-World is an efficient referring expression comprehension model that decouples text-side computation and caches per-token text features to accelerate video frame processing on edge devices.

items.title: An Asymptotic One-Sample Surrogate for Non-Gaussian ERM with General Convex Regularization
items.description: We study convex empirical risk minimization (ERM) with non-Gaussian features and nonsmooth penalties through a surrogate driven by a single Gaussian vector. The surrogate preserves the penalty and calibrates its coefficients using the actual joint law of the feature-label model.
items.ai_summary: Asymptotic one-sample surrogate for convex empirical risk minimization with non-Gaussian features and nonsmooth penalties that preserves penalties and calibrates coefficients using the feature-label joint law.

items.title: SUPERVISE: A Unified Framework for Standardized and Reproducible Superpixel Evaluation
items.description: Image segmentation into superpixels is a widely used technique in computer vision, with a large body of work developed over the years.
items.ai_summary: SUPERVISE is a unified and reproducible evaluation benchmark that enables fair cross-method comparisons of image segmentation superpixels through a scale-normalized protocol.

items.title: Budgeted Subset Selection with a Transferable Learned Value Model
items.description: Subset selection is a fundamental task in machine learning, statistics and combinatorial optimisation, with applications in active learning, band selection, input selection and experimental design.
items.ai_summary: Subset Acquisition with Learned Value Estimates and Search is a framework that decomposes subset selection into value estimation and diversity-penalized search to transfer across tasks.

items.title: RoSci: Exploring Robustness in Science VLMs
items.description: Recent advancements in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) enable significant progress in scientific tasks. However, these models are generally assumed to be presented with complete and accurate information, overlooking the challenges of erroneous/missing information in wild scenarios.
items.ai_summary: RoSci-Bench and the RoSci-Agent framework evaluate and improve vision-language model robustness by vetting premises for errors and inconsistencies before performing scientific reasoning.

items.title: Shared Understanding in Human-AI Teams: Coordination Continuity in Evolving Work
items.description: People are increasingly working with AI agents as part of extended, asynchronous workflows. In these settings, shared access to information does not guarantee a shared basis for action: goals, plans, and roles may persist while their current significance changes.
items.ai_summary: Coordination continuity is a framework that helps collaborators sustain a workable basis for interdependent action during extended, asynchronous workflows with AI agents.

items.title: Pre-Crawl Prioritization and Seed Classification for Large-Scale Web Archiving
items.description: Pre-crawl prioritization systems decide which pages to fetch first before indexing, aiming to improve crawl efficiency and coverage.
items.ai_summary: Pre-crawl prioritization techniques use URL lexical analysis, domain reputation, and predictive content models to improve web-archival crawl completeness while reducing redundant visits.

items.title: Can Vision-Language Models Synthesize Executable Game-Playing Programs?
items.description: Recent advances in vision-language models (VLMs) have endowed multimodal agents with increasingly strong visual perception and long-horizon reasoning capabilities, making VLM-based autonomous game playing feasible.
items.ai_summary: PlayScriptBench is a script-based game benchmark and four-stage pipeline that evaluates whether vision-language models can synthesize executable game-playing programs from game states.

items.title: Average-Depth Variable Execution via Request-Local Token Routing
items.description: Layer skipping can reduce large language model inference costs, but a request budget does not specify how to allocate layer execution across generated tokens.
items.ai_summary: AVERT is a layer-skipping method for large language models that routes tokens to execute varying numbers of layers while matching a continuous per-request depth budget.

items.title: AutoOntologyBench: A Task-Grounded Benchmark for Agentic Knowledge Engineering
items.description: Foundation-model agents are increasingly extending beyond software engineering (SWE) into autonomous scientific research, where acquiring and integrating domain knowledge remains a critical challenge.
items.ai_summary: AutoOntologyBench is a task-grounded benchmark comprising nearly 20,000 tasks across seven domains that evaluates the ability of frontier-model agents to construct ontologies.

items.title: Quantitative Measurement of Pavement Distress based on Vehicle Camera and Perspective Correction
items.description: Using image data is becoming an important method for highway agencies to automatically evaluate pavement conditions. However, most studies focus on improving detection accuracy rather than obtaining quantitative measurements, such as the length or area of pavement distress.
items.ai_summary: A new computer vision method uses lane detection, perspective transformation, and size correction to quantitatively measure pavement distress directly from in-vehicle camera images.

items.title: A Switching Mechanism for Selecting Environment-Adaptive Personalized Gains in Hearing Aids
items.description: Personalized amplification gains for hearing aids have been shown to be preferred over prescriptive gains.
items.ai_summary: A switching mechanism for hearing aids automatically selects personalized amplification gains based on the current background audio environment using a voice activity detector and Bayesian change-point detection.

items.title: Beyond Math, Code, and Logic: Do Reasoning Models Transfer to Scientific Argumentation?
items.description: Scientific discourse depends on argumentative reasoning: identifying claims, evaluating evidence, and constructing coherent responses.
items.ai_summary: Training framework that explicitly scaffolds the argumentative reasoning process in language models improves their competence in scientific discourse and enables reasoning transfer.

items.title: Decision Models for Multilingual Emotion Classification: A Comparative Study Against LLMs and Encoders
items.description: Decision models receive a question with a closed list of answers and return a probability for each answer instead of free text. They promise low latency and robustness to prompt wording, but no study has compared several of them with fine-tuned encoders across languages.
items.ai_summary: Study comparing decision models against LLMs and encoders across languages finds that zero-shot decision models and LLMs achieve performance close to fine-tuned encoders.

items.title: PAWS: A Parametric Model of Canine Pose and Shape
items.description: We introduce PAWS, a parametric model of canine shape and pose, learned from 3D scans of real dogs. Capturing the full diversity of dogs is challenging, as different breeds vary in size, proportion, and body shape.
items.ai_summary: PAWS is a parametric model of canine shape and pose learned from 3D scans of real dogs to support downstream tasks like surface reconstruction and image regression.

items.title: VeilGS: Solving Darkness as a Veil of 2D Basis Maps over Retinex 3DGS
items.description: In a dark capture, the darkness is not uniform. How much light reaches a surface depends on where it lies relative to the few light sources, and the camera compresses what remains with a tone curve.
items.ai_summary: VeilGS is a 3D Gaussian Splatting method for low-light novel view synthesis that treats darkness as a veil drawn over a clear scene to separate surface color from illumination.

items.title: Solving the pre-image problem in kernel PCA: The reproducing property is all you need
items.description: Kernel PCA extends PCA to nonlinear dimensionality reduction by implicitly mapping data into a reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS) via the kernel trick, with applications ranging from image denoising to out-of-distribution detection.
items.ai_summary: Novel reconstruction map for kernel PCA derived using the reproducing property of the reproducing kernel Hilbert space solves the longstanding pre-image problem.

items.title: Recoverable Symbols, Unstable Execution: Auditing Internal Pathways and Decision Identity in Visual State Tracking
items.description: Visual features can retain every symbol a task needs while a model built on them still changes its answer when irrelevant parts of the image change.
items.ai_summary: Diagnostic study on visual state tracking reveals that changing surrounding context lowers the accuracy of recurrent models due to input-dependent rotation phases.

items.title: Efficient inference for fairness-constrained sequential decision policies
items.description: Adaptive decision systems in education and health choose interventions sequentially and are often required not to leave a protected group too far behind.
items.ai_summary: Doubly robust estimator provides efficient inference and confidence intervals for fairness-constrained sequential decision policies in adaptive systems.

items.title: MetaRigor: From Agentic Automation to Verifiable End-to-End Meta-Analysis Through Scientific Decision Boundaries
items.description: Automated meta-analysis requires not only accurate numerical extraction but also the consistent preservation of result identity across stages, including the associated study, comparison, population, outcome, time point, and analysis conditions.
items.ai_summary: MetaRigor is an LLM workflow framework that organizes study results using task contracts and source binding to perform verifiable end-to-end evidence synthesis and meta-analysis.

items.title: When Are Images Needed in Multimodal Machine Translation? Text-Only Routing for On-Demand Visual Context
items.description: Image-guided multimodal machine translation (MMT) leverages visual context to resolve translation-relevant uncertainty. However, prevailing systems either process images unconditionally or apply gating only after visual encoding, leaving redundant visual computation unavoidable.
items.ai_summary: PreVIR is a lightweight, text-only router for multimodal machine translation that determines from source text alone whether visual context is needed to reduce computational overhead.

items.title: w1ccc/sap-data-mcp
items.description: Read-only MCP servers that let AI assistants query SAP S/4HANA through RFC/BAPI, private-cloud OData and public-cloud released APIs. Every call audited; credentials stay local.
items.ai_summary: Read-only Model Context Protocol servers that allow AI assistants to query SAP S/4HANA systems securely through APIs and RFC calls.

items.title: Abstract What Varies, Reuse Longer Patterns: Efficient Offline Chain-of-Thought Compression
items.description: Offline chain-of-thought (CoT) compression creates shorter supervision for efficient reasoning, but per-example compressors repeatedly process similar expressions across traces, wasting compressor budget.
items.ai_summary: CRAFT is an offline chain-of-thought compression method that abstracts problem-specific details into slots to uncover expression templates and construct compact training targets.

items.title: Geometrically Constrained Learning II: Agnostic Proper Learning of Lipschitz Functions
items.description: We give a proper learner for Lipschitz functions over the Gaussian distribution on $\mathbb{R}^d$.
items.ai_summary: Proper learning algorithm that computes globally Lipschitz functions over Gaussian distributions with bounded sample complexity and running time.

items.title: Spatiotemporal Graph Neural Networks for Fault Detection and Structural Learning in Chemical Processes: Use Case on the Tennessee Eastman Process
items.description: Classical Fault Detection and Diagnosis (FDD) methods, including many data-driven approaches, assume a static normal operating space and interpret deviations from a fixed reference as fault indicators.
items.ai_summary: Spatiotemporal Graph Neural Network framework that decomposes normal operating spaces in chemical processes to detect faults under varying conditions.

items.title: Comparative Performance of Machine Learning Architectures for Fault Detection and Diagnosis in Chemical Processes
items.description: Fault Detection and Diagnosis (FDD) is crucial for both maintenance and control in chemical industries, where early fault detection can prevent costly failures and optimize operations.
items.ai_summary: Benchmarking study demonstrating that ensemble learning and bidirectional LSTM models achieve high accuracy for fault detection and diagnosis in chemical processes.

items.title: Embodied-Harness: Towards Recursive Self-Improvement for Robotic Manipulation
items.description: A dual-agent framework with hierarchical memory and recursive self-improvement enables robotic manipulation agents to convert execution evidence into reusable guidance without updating model parameters.
items.ai_summary: Dual-agent framework that improves robotic manipulation performance through recursive execution reflection and experience-driven harness self-improvement without parameter updates.

items.title: Learning in Symbiosis: Heterogeneous Federated Learning with ANNs and SNNs
items.description: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs), widely regarded as the third generation of neural networks, represent a promising neuromorphic computing paradigm with the potential to reduce the energy footprint of Artificial Intelligence (AI).
items.ai_summary: Hybrid neuromorphic federated learning framework that enables joint training of heterogeneous artificial neural networks and spiking neural networks.

items.title: CanopyFormer: Attention-Guided SegFormer for Explainable Forest Cover Segmentation
items.description: In transformer segmentation models, attention is usually visualized after training rather than supervised.
items.ai_summary: Attention-guided SegFormer model that incorporates an attention consistency loss to align canopy attention maps with ground-truth forest segmentation masks.

items.title: Hy-MT3: More Accurate, Robust and Practical Multilingual Translation Models in the Wild
items.description: Hy-MT3 is the third generation of the Hunyuan multilingual translation model family, including \textbf{Hy-MT3-1.8B}, \textbf{Hy-MT3-7B} and \textbf{Hy-MT3-30B-A3B (MoE)}.
items.ai_summary: Multilingual translation model family that reduces mistranslation and instruction-following errors while expanding language coverage to 102 languages.

items.title: GeoScaffold: From Latent to Realized Geometry in Collaborative Detection
items.description: Most collaborative 3D detectors fuse bird's-eye-view (BEV) features from connected vehicles and roadside infrastructure to aggregate complementary observations.
items.ai_summary: Training-only auxiliary objective that improves collaborative 3D detection by predicting dense spatial foreground masks to enhance box localization.

items.title: Can pretrained Transformers deliver semiparametrically efficient inference?
items.description: Semiparametric models provide a broad framework for statistical inference, yet efficient estimation typically relies on influence function correction tailored to each estimand and on nuisance estimation repeated for every sample.
items.ai_summary: Pretrained Transformer method that performs semiparametrically efficient estimation and valid statistical inference in a single forward pass.

items.title: SMSD: A Semantic Misinformation Spreader Detection Approach
items.description: Misinformation spreaders on social media significantly amplify false narratives, making early detection critical to mitigate their spread.
items.ai_summary: Multimodal semantic misinformation spreader detection approach that models user-level, network-level, and conversation propagation features using stance-aware labeling.

items.title: marketzy/codex-cli-repo-workbench
items.description: Codex Cli Repo Workbench provides a local workspace for managing and inspecting Codex CLI repository
items.ai_summary: Command-line utility for Windows that provides a scriptable interface to inspect and operate on local Git repositories.

items.title: Beyond Sample Hardness: Adaptive Data Selection through Learning Dynamics
items.description: Data selection has emerged as an effective approach to reducing the model training costs. However, most existing methods often rely heavily on sample hardness, which may overlook differences in sample learning dynamics and lead to suboptimal sample selection.
items.ai_summary: LeDAS is a learning dynamics-aware framework for adaptive data selection that jointly characterizes sample importance to reduce model training costs with marginal overhead.

items.title: Late-Time Dynamics of Flow Matching: Distance Geometry and Learning
items.description: Generative models transform simple random inputs into samples that resemble observed data. For a finite training set, a central question is how its geometry shapes the terminal dynamics and the probabilities assigned to individual samples.
items.ai_summary: A new method for flow matching generative models analyzes terminal dynamics using squared distance geometry to derive explicit contraction paths and two learning approaches.

items.title: Auditing Post-Training Unlearning in Diffusion Language Models using Sparse Autoencoders
items.description: Machine unlearning is an approach to privacy protection: it aims to remove the influence of designated data while preserving the model's behavior on information that should be retained.
items.ai_summary: Sparse autoencoders are used to audit post-trial unlearning in diffusion language models by analyzing forget-data-associated feature shifts across iterative denoising stages.

items.title: zavi2997-droid/claude-code-agent-workspace
items.description: Orchestrates composable Claude Code agent workflows across isolated workspace contexts.
items.ai_summary: Command-line tool for Windows that provisions and manages isolated workspaces and lifecycle commands for Claude Code agents.

items.title: wozniakalan323-bit/opencode-project-workbench
items.description: Opencode Project Workbench structures opencode project tasks, files, and workflow state.
items.ai_summary: Command-line tool for Windows that manages the creation, configuration, and cleanup of local OpenCode project workspaces.

items.title: MoHA: Model-Conditioned Harness Adaptation for Long-Video Agents
items.description: Long-video understanding increasingly relies on agentic systems that actively acquire evidence rather than process fixed video representations.
items.ai_summary: MoHA is a model-conditioned harness adaptation framework that optimizes execution harnesses for long-video agents by diagnosing mismatches and calibrating observer configurations.

items.title: Efficient VLA Reinforcement Learning via Subchunk Rollouts in Latent World Models
items.description: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) can improve pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) policies through imagined experiences. However, existing VLA-MBRL methods primarily rely on large-scale image or video generation world models, incurring large computational overhead.
items.ai_summary: LS-MBPO is a lightweight residual model-based reinforcement learning framework that leverages latent world models to efficiently improve pretrained vision-language-action policies.

items.title: Beyond Resolution: Inference-Time Parameterized Temporal Consistency in Generative Regional Climate Downscaling
items.description: GCM-to-RCM downscaling emulation is dominated by generative diffusion models, but most existing work evaluates skill only per timestep, treating each field as an independent snapshot.
items.ai_summary: A noise-conditioned training scheme for generative regional climate downscaling models continuously interpolates between autoregressive and independent sampling via a single noise parameter.

items.title: SOAR: Training-Free Rank-Consistent Rollout Compression for Latent World Model Planning
items.description: Latent world models plan by rolling out hundreds of candidate action sequences through a transformer predictor, so a single decision can take tens of seconds.
items.ai_summary: SOAR is a training-free rollout compression method for latent world model planning that dynamically adapts token budgets to speed up decision-making without losing candidate rankings.

items.title: Seeing Is Not Steering: Where Verifiable Reasoning Can Enter an End-to-End Driving Planner
items.description: Driving models that reason may describe a hazard correctly while choosing their path for other reasons. We study where scene reasoning can enter an end-to-end planner so its influence can be checked.
items.ai_summary: A study on end-to-end driving planners evaluates rule-based fact checks using scene reasoning to make vehicle path interventions auditable.

items.title: Learning Inside Types: Epistemic Typestates for Safe Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
items.description: Type disciplines make programs safe by construction: components checked against each other's types compose into programs that cannot go wrong in the ways the types exclude.
items.ai_summary: Epistemic typestates are a type discipline for safe multi-agent reinforcement learning that constrains agent choices based on belief states to prevent safety violations.

items.title: Segment Everything, Materialize Nothing: Exact Streaming Inference for Many-Class 3D Segmentation
items.description: Whole-body segmentation tools such as TotalSegmentator and MOOSE split more than 100 classes across five or six networks. The reason is memory.
items.ai_summary: A streaming inference method for many-class 3D segmentation eliminates high memory consumption by streaming local network features through a ring without lowering accuracy.

items.title: Points, Not Pixels: Keypoints, Masks and Oblique Geometry for Floating-Roof Tank Fill Estimation from Overhead Imagery
items.description: The floating roof of an oil storage tank rests on the stored liquid, so its depth below the rim measures how full the tank is. In optical overhead imagery, this depth appears only as the crescent shadow the rim casts on the roof, often a few pixels wide.
items.ai_summary: A keypoint pipeline and closed-form estimator use optical overhead imagery and physical geometry to estimate the fill levels of floating-roof oil storage tanks.

items.title: Benchmarks' Last Exam
items.description: Public benchmarks guide model selection, post-training rewards and claims of progress in artificial intelligence, yet leaderboards report aggregate scores without verifying whether each task's prompt, environment and grader agree on what counts as success.
items.ai_summary: A synthesis of task-level quality reviews across 749 tasks reveals that benchmark validity varies heavily by grading architecture and container isolation.

items.title: Automating Multi-View Quality Assessment of 3D Annotation Layouts
items.description: Text labels provide descriptive information about elements in visual scenes. In 3D visualization, the arrangement of these labels and their connections to target locations forms an annotation layout. Assessing layout quality supports comparisons between alternative layouts.
items.ai_summary: A multimodal large language model fine-tuned on human ratings assesses the multi-view quality of 3D annotation layouts.

items.title: Sketch2TikZ: Multi-Reward Reinforcement Learning for Converting Hand-Drawn Sketches to Executable TikZ
items.description: Automatic digitization of hand-drawn sketches into editable formats is crucial for modern document workflows and LaTeX integration.
items.ai_summary: Sketch2TikZ uses a multi-reward reinforcement learning framework to convert hand-drawn sketches into executable TikZ code with high visual and textual alignment.

items.title: Potential emergence in LLM agents: a statistical physics perspective
items.description: There has been significant recent interest in understanding the behaviour of LLM agents from the perspective of human preferences or corpus statistics. In this paper we propose agent states as intermediate variables through which post-training can be measured and predicted.
items.ai_summary: A statistical physics framework models intermediate agent states as variables governed by a global potential to track how post-training organizes language model agent behavior.

items.title: Circular Predictive Coding Unlocks Effective Depth
items.description: Predictive coding networks perform credit assignment through an energy minimization process. Despite their ability to train models with arbitrary network topologies, they have mostly been used to train feedforward architectures to match the performance of backpropagation.
items.ai_summary: Circular predictive coding networks derive depth from energy minimization rather than stacked layers, improving performance on image classification, constraint satisfaction, and language modeling.

items.title: Quantum-Informed Regularized Poisson Learning for Graph-Based Semi-Supervised Classification
items.description: We introduce IPQSSL, a quantum-informed regularized Poisson framework for graph-based semi-supervised classification under scarce labels.
items.ai_summary: IPQSSL combines a quantum-informed variational circuit with a regularized Poisson framework to perform graph-based semi-supervised classification under scarce labels.

items.title: Tasklets: A Unit-Test Benchmark for Language Model Architectures
items.description: We introduce Tasklets, a benchmark of small synthetic tasks for evaluating the computational capabilities of language model sequence-mixing layers. These tasks probe foundational capabilities such as recall, sequence manipulation, and state tracking.
items.ai_summary: Tasklets is a benchmark of small synthetic tasks designed to evaluate and compare the computational capabilities of language model sequence-mixing layers.

items.title: Adapting AI Weather Foundation Models to a Changing Climate
items.description: AI weather foundation models learn from historical archives, while the climate distribution encountered during deployment continues to evolve.
items.ai_summary: An online adaptation framework uses flow-dependent corrections and residual memory to update AI weather foundation models against climate distribution changes without full retraining.

items.title: PromptTTSD: Controllable Text to Spoken Dialogue Synthesis with Open-Ended Text Descriptions
items.description: Spoken dialogue synthesis aims to generate multi-turn conversational speech from dialogue scripts while maintaining speaker consistency and contextual appropriateness.
items.ai_summary: PromptTTSD is an open-source spoken dialogue synthesis model that supports natural language style control and zero-shot voice cloning using conversational data and open-ended prompts.

items.title: Block Search Conditioned on Features for Sequential Quantum Data Encoding
items.description: Sequential quantum data encoding is addressed through the joint selection of input features and encoding blocks within a fixed quantum register.
items.ai_summary: Sequential quantum data encoding method that jointly selects input features and encoding blocks to improve balanced accuracy and reduce cross-entropy on quantum datasets.

items.title: Leakage-Free Is Not Confounder-Free: What a Patient-Level Split Cannot Certify About a Medical Imaging Benchmark
items.description: Patient-level splitting is the standard safeguard against subject leakage in medical imaging evaluation, but it cannot remove a confounder that every fold inherits: an acquisition variable aligned with the diagnosis across the whole cohort.
items.ai_summary: Audit framework for medical imaging benchmarks that evaluates how acquisition variables act as hidden confounders capable of artificially inflating predictive performance.

items.title: Do DeepONet Trunk-Basis Preconditioners Need Training?
items.description: Trunk-basis (TB) preconditioners build the coarse space of a two-level Schwarz preconditioner from the trunk functions of a trained deep operator network (DeepONet), restricted to subdomains.
items.ai_summary: Analysis of trunk-basis preconditioners proving that untrained networks with smooth activations can build effective coarse spaces for solving partial differential equations.

items.title: PRISM: Validation-Free Online Batch Selection for LLM Fine-Tuning via Preconditioned Conic Ghost Matching
items.description: Online batch selection lowers the cost of fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) by replacing each candidate batch with a smaller informative subset.
items.ai_summary: Validation-free online batch selection method for fine-tuning large language models by aligning candidate gradients in a factored second-moment metric using conic facility location.

items.title: Unlocking Heterogeneous Accelerator Flexibility in AI Data Centers: Sizing and Workload Allocation
items.description: AI data centers are an emerging electricity demand, but limited local grid capacity could delay their connection and expansion.
items.ai_summary: Capacity planning model for AI data centers that jointly sizes and allocates heterogeneous accelerators across sites to minimize daily electricity costs under grid constraints.

items.title: Minimax-Optimal Small-Loss Regret in Online Convex Optimization and Applications to Contextual Search and Online Inverse Optimization
items.description: We give small-loss regret bounds for online convex optimization (OCO), using one subgradient per round. Let $Δ_T^\star$ denote the cumulative loss of the best fixed decision in hindsight, measured relative to the per-round minima.
items.ai_summary: Online convex optimization algorithm that achieves minimax-optimal small-loss regret bounds using a single subgradient per round without prior knowledge of the loss.

items.title: WEIR: Watershed Exploration and Drift-Aware Prefix Shrinkage for Multi-Turn Agent Reinforcement Learning
items.description: Multi-turn language model agents often receive only a single binary reward at the end of a long interaction trajectory, making it difficult to separate decisive decisions from routine steps or estimate accurate intermediate values.
items.ai_summary: Actor-critic reinforcement learning framework for multi-turn language model agents that uses watershed exploration and drift-aware prefix shrinkage to improve sample efficiency.

items.title: TITAN: DRL-Based Dynamic Scheduling and Resource Allocation for Tactile Internet
items.description: Tactile Internet (TI) applications require ultra-reliable, low-latency tactile communication alongside video traffic. However, tactile Quality of Service (QoS) requirements vary with the interaction context, making fixed resource allocation inefficient.
items.ai_summary: Dynamic scheduling and resource allocation scheme for 5G access networks that uses deep reinforcement learning to balance tactile and video traffic QoS requirements.

items.title: Can Language Models See the Circuit in Pixelated RFIC Passives?
items.description: The emergence of inverse-designed, pixelated passives for microwave and millimeter-wave applications has been a major development in the field of RFIC design.
items.ai_summary: Method evaluating frontier language models on reading, predicting, and debugging pixelated RFIC passive layouts to help engineers interpret complex high-frequency circuit structures.

items.title: Bringing AI Assistance to the Beznau Nuclear Power Plant: A Hierarchical System of LLM Agents for Reactor Monitoring
items.description: Beznau Unit 1 in Switzerland, in operation since 1969, is the most experienced nuclear reactor still running worldwide.
items.ai_summary: Hierarchical multi-agent LLM assistant designed to help engineers query fragmented nuclear power plant databases and documents while maintaining strict traceability.

items.title: Vega-Fafnir: Is Greedy Decoding the Same Decoding? Where Rounding Noise in Speculative Verification Comes From and What Removing It Costs
items.description: Serving engines treat the ways of running a greedy language model as interchangeable: cached or not, padded or not, alone or batched, one token or several verified at once (speculative decoding). In finite precision they round differently.
items.ai_summary: Research paper investigating how finite precision rounding noise causes divergence in speculative decoding and greedy language model generation.

items.title: Altair-Nidhogg: Which Model-Merging Theories Hold for a One-Pass Decision Encoder? Soups, Task Arithmetic, TIES and DARE Against Joint Training and Prediction Ensembling
items.description: Laya is a small model that answers a multiple-choice question in one pass: each option has a name and a written description.
items.ai_summary: Research paper evaluating model-merging techniques and their underlying theories on a one-pass decision encoder model called Laya.

items.title: GameScrub: Learning HUD Removal from Real Gameplay with Recovered Targets
items.description: Gameplay videos are a rich source of experience for learning virtual-world dynamics, yet their frames contain heads-up displays (HUDs) that follow interface rules rather than scene dynamics. Removing HUDs would make this footage directly usable for learning world dynamics.
items.ai_summary: Research paper introducing GameScrub, a video diffusion model that removes heads-up displays from gameplay videos using pseudo-clean target recovery.

items.title: Alliance Rupture and Repair in Simulating Cognitive Behavioral Therapy Dialogues
items.description: In cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT), routine work can strain the client-counselor working alliance, and the counselor must then notice the rupture, repair it, and adapt the work that follows.
items.ai_summary: Research paper presenting ALLY, a simulation framework that models cognitive behavioral therapy dialogues by incorporating alliance rupture, repair, and replanning.

items.title: On the Limits of Observability for Evaluating Coverage in Machine Unlearning
items.description: Machine unlearning aims to remove the influence of any requested subset of training data while preserving utility on the remaining data. Empirical evaluations measure predictive accuracy and infer training-set membership (MIAs) from model outputs or intermediate activations.
items.ai_summary: Research paper proposing CEO, a framework for evaluating machine unlearning coverage under limited observability using a compositional benchmark.

items.title: When Visually Rich Documents Meet Multi-Vector Retrieval for Region-level Retrieval-Augmented Generation
items.description: Visually rich documents (VRDs) convey knowledge through textual, visual, and layout information that text-centric Retrieval-Augmented Generation (Text-RAG) struggles to fully exploit.
items.ai_summary: Research paper introducing MV-VisRAG, a region-level Vision-RAG framework that uses multi-vector retrieval and regionalization for visually rich documents.

items.title: From Tokens to Pixels: Training-Free Guided Upsampling of Frozen CARL Features for Hyperspectral Imaging
items.description: Camera-agnostic foundation models such as CARL map spectral images from arbitrary sensors into a shared feature space, but deliver their features only on a token grid at one eighth of the input resolution.
items.ai_summary: Research paper showing that joint bilateral upsampling sharpens feature boundaries for frozen camera-agnostic foundation models in hyperspectral imaging without training.

items.title: Open CDLM: A Benchmark and Library for Continuous Diffusion Language Models
items.description: Reliable comparisons of continuous diffusion language models (CDLMs) require evaluating both model fit and the distribution of generated text. Two common practices leave this goal only partially addressed.
items.ai_summary: Research paper introducing Open CDLM, an open-source benchmark and library for evaluating continuous diffusion language models and their samplers.

items.title: Fix Where It Fails: Root-Cause-Guided Agentic Harness Optimization for Scene Graph Generation
items.description: Scene graph generation (SGG) aims to detect objects in an image and predict the relationships between them. The standard PredCls, SGCls, and SGDet settings show how much performance drops without ground-truth boxes and labels, but not where or why a model fails.
items.ai_summary: Research paper presenting RoHa-SGG, a root-cause-guided agentic harness optimization method that improves scene graph generation models without retraining.

items.title: PaMuk-Bench: A Parallel Multilingual Multitask Benchmark for Vision-Language Tasks
items.description: While vision-language models (VLMs) currently obtain notable results for highly-studied languages, e.g. English, they exhibit significant performance drops in certain low-resource languages, especially due to the lack of annotated datasets.
items.ai_summary: Research paper proposing PaMuk-Bench, a parallel multilingual multitask benchmark for evaluating vision-language models across low-resource and high-resource languages.

items.title: EchoAlign: Echocardiography foundation model with multilevel report alignment
items.description: Echocardiography assesses the structure and function of the heart. Cardiologists read each study across several standard views and report the findings visible in those views by cardiac structure.
items.ai_summary: EchoAlign is a vision-language foundation model trained on echocardiographic videos to detect clinical findings, grade severity, and estimate measurements with high accuracy.

items.title: PhiJEPA: Denoising Latent Predictions for Visual Representation Learning
items.description: Can a predictor trained to infer hidden image regions still help a world model plan when part of an object disappears from view and the visible context is blurred?
items.ai_summary: PhiJEPA is a joint-embedding predictive architecture that uses two-stage latent prediction to learn visual representations, improving segmentation accuracy and handling object occlusion in open-loop planning.

items.title: Beyond a Single Human Demonstration: Learning from Scored Trajectory Alternatives for End-to-End Driving
items.description: Human driving logs record only one trajectory per scene, leaving other feasible driving choices without explicit trajectory targets or quality labels. This limits supervision for end-to-end planners that generate and refine multiple candidate trajectories.
items.ai_summary: DriveSTA is an end-to-end driving planner that uses scored trajectory alternatives and a shared joint-embedding predictive architecture to improve driving quality assessment and reduce inference latency.

items.title: Deep Cross-Division Network for Product-and-Ratio Feature Interactions in Industrial Ranking
items.description: Learning effective feature interactions is essential for industrial recommender systems. DCN and DCNv2 efficiently automate polynomial feature crossing.
items.ai_summary: DCDN is a Deep Cross-Division Network that integrates a division branch into cross layers to jointly learn product and ratio feature interactions, improving performance in industrial recommendation systems.

items.title: PGS-PCQA: Perceptually Gated Synthetic Supervision for No-Reference Point Cloud Quality Assessment
items.description: Existing no-reference point cloud quality assessment (NR-PCQA) methods perform well within individual datasets but generalize poorly across datasets.
items.ai_summary: PGS-PCQA is a no-reference point cloud quality assessment model trained with synthetic distortion ranking and a perceptual gate, improving cross-dataset generalization and correlation with subjective scores.

items.title: Breaking the Barrier of Hard Samples: A Data-Centric Approach to Synthetic Data for Medical Tasks
items.description: Data scarcity and quality issues remain significant barriers to developing robust predictive models in medical research. Traditional reliance on real-world data often leads to biased models with poor generalizability across diverse patient populations.
items.ai_summary: Profile2Gen is a data-centric framework that guides the generation and refinement of synthetic data to reduce predictive errors and enhance model reliability on hard-to-learn samples in medical regression tasks.

items.title: Self-Supervised Continuous-Time Depth Learning and Ego-Motion Estimation from Asynchronous Events
items.description: Event cameras register brightness changes pixel by pixel with microsecond precision, whereas the dense depth that could supervise them is costly to acquire and exists only at isolated instants.
items.ai_summary: A self-supervised event-based approach uses continuous-time depth learning and camera motion recovery to estimate dense depth maps and ego-motion from asynchronous event streams without requiring costly ground-truth depth.

items.title: How Many Bytes Has a BPE Model Seen? Estimating Byte-Token Exposure in Pretraining from Corpus Statistics and Embedding Norms
items.description: Byte-level BPE vocabularies retain 256 single-byte fallback tokens. When converting such a model into a pure byte-level model, these tokens provide the starting embeddings. How much training have they received?
items.ai_summary: This study estimates byte-token exposure in pretrained language models by combining corpus statistics with embedding and output-matrix row norms to evaluate script coverage and fallback token usage.

items.title: The Assistant Persona Differs Across Languages in Activation Space
items.description: Large language models behave differently across languages, and are noticeably less safe in lower-resource languages. This gap is well established behaviorally, but not mechanistically.
items.ai_summary: Analysis of Qwen3-32B reveals that the assistant persona direction in activation space varies significantly across languages and correlates with resource levels, indicating that the model lacks a single universal assistant representation.

items.title: Solar-Conditioned Flow Matching for Multitemporal Aerial Visible-to-Infrared Image Translation
items.description: Aerial visible-to-infrared (V2IR) image translation provides scalable thermal data across the full diurnal cycle. However, existing methods predominantly learn a static mapping within narrow acquisition windows.
items.ai_summary: Solar-Flow is a flow-matching generator conditioned on physical solar factors that translates a single visible aerial image into plausible infrared images across different times of day.

items.title: Turnout: Adaptive Attention Switching for Efficient Reasoning
items.description: Post-hoc transformer linearization replaces the key-value cache of full attention, which grows linearly with generation length, with a fixed size state. This change reduces memory consumption but often hurts accuracy.
items.ai_summary: Turnout is a hybrid model method that uses a learned policy to switch between full and linear attention, improving efficiency on reasoning tasks.

items.title: Constraint-Aware Anticlustering Decomposition for Certifying Pairwise-Constrained Clustering
items.description: Certifying the quality of feasible solutions to large-scale minimum sum-of-squares clustering with pairwise must-link and cannot-link constraints remains challenging, as it requires strong lower bounds on the optimal objective value.
items.ai_summary: A decomposition framework partitions data into anticlusters to certify pairwise-constrained clustering quality and obtain lower bounds on large-scale problems.

items.title: Trained on Harm, Still Refusing: A Training-Time Defense for Code Generation
items.description: Fine-tuning enables safety-aligned code language models to adapt to diverse downstream tasks. However, training on untrusted data can severely undermine their ability to refuse harmful requests.
items.ai_summary: SAFEHOLD is a training-time defense framework that preserves safety alignment in code language models during fine-tuning by treating refusal as a sustained generation process.

items.title: Typhoon OCR 2: From Thai Document Transcription to Multilingual, Multi-Task OCR
items.description: Typhoon OCR 1.5 focused on reading Thai documents. However, in real-world workflows, users often need to extract specific information or preserve the structure of an entire page for further processing.
items.ai_summary: Typhoon OCR 2 is a multilingual optical character recognition model that handles prompt-driven extraction and structured full-page parsing across Thai, English, and Chinese documents.

items.title: Learning Unknown Oscillators From Bandit Feedback
items.description: We study semi-bandits driven by unknown oscillators. Each round, a learner selects two of four reward channels and observes their individual rewards. Frequency errors change future reward rankings and the resulting measurements.
items.ai_summary: A semi-bandit learning approach uses unknown oscillators and online regression policies to bound reward loss and reduce computational fitting requirements across frequencies.

items.title: LIUFelix2004/dsh-workbuddy
items.description: Import WorkBuddy accounts into DeepSeek Harness as model providers: one route per account, full model list, per-account credit balance, and an automatic workaround for the gateway 11128 channel check.
items.ai_summary: Integration tool that imports WorkBuddy accounts into DeepSeek Harness to route requests, pool models, and check credit balances.

items.title: cmHC: Balancing Stream Mixing in Hyper-Connections via Geometric Contraction
items.description: Constraining residual stream mixing within the Birkhoff polytope via geometric contraction improves stability and scalability of hyper-connections in large-scale dense and mixture-of-experts model pretraining.

items.title: Explicit Style Extraction for Personalized Long-Form Text Generation
items.description: A method that explicitly extracts a user's stylistic profile and uses it to guide drafting and revision improves personalized long-form text generation over retrieval-augmented baselines.

items.title: Prune to Expand: Training Prompt Enhancers with Less to Imitate
items.description: Prune to Expand (P2E) refines dense-caption supervision by selectively removing redundant sentences under a per-example deletion bound, improving prompt enhancement alignment with human preferences and visual quality over conventional dense-caption supervised fine-tuning.

items.title: inclusionAI/LingSante-3.1-flash
items.description: Text generation model from inclusionAI. 0 downloads and 68 likes so far.

items.title: Duopra: From Full-Duplex Conversation to Full-Duplex Agency
items.description: Full-duplex interaction models exhibit strong conversational agency, enabling natural, low-latency turn-taking, backchannels, and interruptions. However, completing tasks further requires task agency: timely tool invocation and argument revision following user corrections.

items.title: lukendeasy/open-diagram
items.description: Python building blocks for dense architecture diagrams that check their own layout
items.ai_summary: Python-based diagramming tool that uses font measurements and layout checks to generate clean architecture diagrams from short scripts.

items.title: naheel0/dev-skills
items.description: Agent skills for dev.to - write in your voice, audit what worked, feed the results into the next draft.
items.ai_summary: Set of agent skills designed to help users write, audit, and repurpose dev.to posts using personalized voice profiles.

items.title: Echoxiawan/Astra
items.description: Natural-language mobile UI testing with AI execution on real Android/iOS devices, generating standalone pytest + Appium scripts. 用自然语言写移动端测试用例，AI 在 Android / iOS 真机上执行，跑通后生成可独立运行的 pytest + Appium 脚本。
items.ai_summary: Open-source UI automation platform that converts natural language test cases into pytest and Appium scripts executed on real Android and iOS devices.

items.title: AeroRSI: Recursive Self-Improvement for Aerial Vision-Language Navigation
items.description: Vision-language-action (VLA) models enable unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) to follow natural-language instructions, yet still fail frequently in closed-loop flight.

items.title: alphafalcongamer-creator/ai--manus2.0
items.description: AI Manus is a general-purpose AI Agent system that supports running various tools and operations in a sandbox environment.
